title: Finance & Operations (Remote, Part-Time → Full-Time, 20 hrs/week to start)
description:
Nomad Self Storage | Bali-based startup | Philippines applicants



About us

Nomad Self Storage is a fast-growing premium valet and self-storage company in Bali, with locations in Canggu and Uluwatu. We're a lean, founder-led team moving quickly. We need someone who brings order to the chaos and doesn't wait to be told what to do.



The role

You'll be the right hand to our CEO. I'm a fast-paced founder, and I need someone who can get in the trenches with me. You'll take on the work I don't have time for or am not strong at, own it completely, and see it through without me having to micromanage.



This is not a fixed task list. The work will change week to week as the business grows. The right person enjoys that variety, works out what needs doing, and gets it done properly.



The kind of work you'll own (examples, not a fixed list)



Admin & operations



Updating and maintaining company accounts, platforms and records

Keeping our records clean, organised and easy to find

Running document workflows, e.g. staff contracts from draft through review, legal, signing and filing

Following up with suppliers, shipping and customs paperwork

Supporting our co-founder with tasks under my direction



Accounting & finance



Running and improving our AI-assisted bookkeeping system, making sure it stays accurate and up to date

Reconciling receipts against bank statements and keeping the books current

Making sure our accountant has everything they need, on time

Paying invoices through our banking platforms (founder approval required)

Keeping our international company records up to date and fees paid



Keeping me organised



Managing my calendar and keeping me on top of important deadlines and priorities

Taking notes in meetings, logging decisions, and chasing action items

Flagging what needs my attention before it becomes urgent



Who you are



An owner. When you take on a job, it's yours until it's done.

Detail-oriented and meticulous. You catch the things others miss.

Proactive. You come with solutions, not just questions.

Comfortable with fast-paced, changing priorities.

Trustworthy and discreet with financial and personal information.

Wants to grow with us. This role will expand as the business does.



You must have



3+ years supporting a founder, executive or business owner, working in English

Hands-on bookkeeping experience in Xero, QuickBooks or similar

Comfortable using AI and automation tools, and able to set up, run and improve systems rather than just follow them

Excellent written and spoken English

Strong Google Sheets/Excel skills

Availability for 20 hours a week, including fixed core hours of 10am–2pm Bali time (UTC+8), Monday–Friday



Nice to have



Experience working with a startup or fast-growing business operating across more than one country

Accounting or finance degree

Experience with multi-currency banking (e.g. Airwallex) or international company structures

Experience building systems in Notion or similar



Pay & growth

USD $650/month for 20 hours a week, paid monthly via Wise or Airwallex, with a pay review after 3 months. This is an independent contractor role. It will become full-time as the business grows, with pay and responsibility increasing to match. We're looking for someone who wants to build something long-term with us.



How to apply

Start your application with the word "Seseh" so we know you've read this ad. Then include:



Your CV

Which accounting software you've used, and for how long

Answers to the three questions below, in your own words. Please don't use AI. I want to hear how you think and how you'd talk to me. Short, honest and human beats polished every time.



Question 1: About a third of our receipts aren't filed. They're scattered across WhatsApp chats, Tokopedia orders and Alibaba orders. How would you track them down and reconcile them? And what system would you set up so that both founders never end up in this position again?



Question 2: We've lost the login to our business TikTok account. How would you go about recovering it?



Question 3: We have three staff who need employment contracts. Each contract needs to be drafted, reviewed by the staff member, checked by our legal team, then signed and lodged. We're a foreign-owned company in Indonesia (a PT PMA). How would you manage this process from start to finish, while keeping both founders informed at every stage?

You don't need to know Indonesian law already. We want to see how you'd approach it.



Applications that don't start with the code word won't be reviewed. Replies that are clearly written by a real person, in your own voice, will be given priority.



Next steps

Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid trial task (USD $50) on real work before we make a final decision.

title: Healthcare, Courier & Logistics Contract Opportunity Researcher
description:
# Virtual Assistant – Healthcare, Courier & Logistics Contract Opportunity Researcher



**Part-Time | Remote | 5–10 Hours Per Week**



We are seeking a highly resourceful Virtual Assistant to **research, identify, track, and assist with applications for commercial healthcare, medical courier, and logistics contract opportunities.**



This is **not a government contracting position**.



### Primary Responsibilities



- Research commercial healthcare, courier, delivery, and logistics contract opportunities.

- Find companies currently seeking couriers, delivery partners, subcontractors, vendors, or local logistics providers.

- Identify medical courier routes and contract opportunities.

- Research subcontracting opportunities with established healthcare logistics companies.

- Identify vendor opportunities with pharmacies, laboratories, home-infusion companies, DME suppliers, medical-supply companies, hospitals, healthcare organizations, and related businesses.

- Determine basic qualification and application requirements.

- Locate application links, vendor portals, procurement contacts, operations contacts, or decision-makers.

- Complete routine applications and vendor registrations when authorized.

- Follow up on submitted applications and inquiries.

- Maintain an organized opportunity tracker showing status, contacts, deadlines, follow-up dates, and next steps.



### Opportunities We Want Researched



Examples include:



- Medical courier contracts

- Specimen and laboratory delivery

- Pharmacy and prescription delivery

- Specialty pharmacy delivery

- Home-infusion supply delivery

- Wound-care supply delivery

- DME and medical-equipment delivery

- Medical/surgical supply delivery

- Scheduled healthcare delivery routes

- STAT/on-demand medical delivery

- Healthcare last-mile delivery

- Courier subcontracting

- Healthcare logistics subcontracting

- Commercial healthcare vendor opportunities



### Ideal Candidate



We prefer someone with experience researching **contracts, business opportunities, jobs/gigs, courier routes, logistics opportunities, vendor opportunities, or B2B leads**.



Experience with healthcare, medical courier, transportation, logistics, or commercial contract research is strongly preferred.



You must be able to go beyond simply creating lists of companies. We are looking for **real, actionable opportunities that our company can pursue.**



### When Applying



Please provide:



1. Your experience researching contract or business opportunities.

2. Any experience with healthcare, courier, transportation, or logistics research.

3. The websites, databases, job boards, platforms, and research methods you use to locate opportunities.

4. Whether you have experience completing vendor registrations or company applications.

5. Your hourly rate and availability.

6. One example of how you would search for **commercial medical courier or healthcare logistics contract opportunities in Maryland**.



**Important: This role is focused on commercial opportunities, not government contracts.**

title: Part-Time Social Media Manager and Short-Form Video Editor
description:
PART-TIME SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER & SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR



ABOUT THE ROLE



We help businesses build a strong, consistent presence on social media. Our clients send us raw video footage, and we turn it into scroll-stopping content for their accounts.



We're looking for a reliable, creative Social Media Manager & Video Editor who can:

• Set up client Instagram,
, and TikTok accounts properly

• Edit raw footage into polished short-form vertical videos (Reels, TikToks, Shorts)

• Write captions and schedule or post content to client accounts



This is a part-time contract role. Strong performers will be offered a long-term monthly retainer.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Platform Setup & Onboarding

• Set up Instagram,
, and TikTok accounts from scratch: profile photos, bios, cover graphics, highlights, and links

• Configure business settings, Meta Business Suite, and team permissions

• Organize logins securely and hand accounts over to clients smoothly when required



Video Editing & Production

• Edit raw footage and B-roll into short-form vertical videos

• Create strong hooks in the first 1–3 seconds

• Add captions/subtitles, text overlays, transitions, music, and sound effects

• Keep cuts clean, pacing tight, and branding consistent with each client



Content Posting & Scheduling

• Write engaging captions with clear calls to action

• Research and select relevant hashtags

• Schedule posts through Meta Business Suite and TikTok, or post manually when needed

• Keep a simple posting log for each client



REQUIRED SKILLS & TOOLS



• Proven experience editing short-form vertical video

• CapCut (required); Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve is a plus

• Meta Business Suite for scheduling and account management

• Canva for graphics, covers, and thumbnails

• Good understanding of trends, hooks, and what performs on short-form platforms

• Good written English

• Reliable with deadlines and clear communication

• Stable internet and a computer capable of video editing



Nice to have: experience setting up business accounts for clients, basic analytics knowledge, and experience with small businesses or local brands.



COMPENSATION & WORKING TERMS



• Type: Part-time / contract (freelance)

• Rate: $5–$10 per hour, or $15 per completed video (up to 60 seconds). Negotiable for experienced editors.

• Hours: 10–20 hours per week, flexible, with deadlines per batch of videos

• Availability: Some overlap with business hours (EST / UTC-5) is preferred for communication

• Paid test task: Shortlisted applicants will complete a short PAID trial edit so we can review editing quality and turnaround time before a longer arrangement

• Growth: Consistent, high-quality work leads to a monthly retainer



HOW TO APPLY



Please include ALL of the following. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.



1. 3 links to short-form vertical videos you edited (Google Drive, YouTube, or social links)

2. Links to social media pages you have managed or helped grow

3. Your rate per video and/or per hour

4. Your weekly availability (hours per week)

5. Confirmation that you are open to a short paid test task



Please start your response with the subject line: [SMM + Video Editor - Ready for Paid Test]



We look forward to seeing your work!

title: Social Media Marketer and Graphic Designer
description:
The Paradise Lounge is looking for a creative, organized, and efficient social media marketer and graphic designer to help promote our group travel experiences.



We create curated trips centered on culture, affordable luxury, connection, and self-care, primarily for Black women ages 40 and better. We also offer select co-ed trips.



We need someone who learns quickly, understands our audience, and can turn trip details into attractive graphics and engaging content that encourages inquiries and bookings.



**Hours & Work Arrangement**



- Remote, part-time: **20 hours per month**.

- Flexible working hours with agreed deadlines.

- Content prepared in batches and submitted for approval before scheduling.

- Some availability to communicate during U.S. Eastern business hours.



**Responsibilities**



- Plan and prepare content to support **three social media posts per day**, approximately 90 posts per month.

- Use a mix of reusable branded templates, existing trip photos and videos, repurposed content, and new promotional assets to meet that schedule within the allotted hours.

- Design trip flyers, destination graphics, carousels, webinar promotions, countdowns, testimonials, and availability announcements.

- Write engaging captions with clear calls to action.

- Repurpose supplied footage into simple reels and short promotional videos.

- Schedule approved content through Metricool.

- Organize editable designs and finished assets in clearly labeled Google Drive folders.

- Review basic content performance and suggest improvements.



Not every post requires a new graphic. We expect thoughtful repurposing and efficient production while maintaining quality.



**What We’re Looking For**



- A strong portfolio of social media graphics and marketing content.

- Proficiency in Canva, including creating and using editable brand templates.

- Experience writing captions and editing short videos.

- A fast learner who can understand travel offers, payment plans, booking timelines, and the difference between generating engagement and generating inquiries.

- Ability to create clean, modern, sophisticated designs for a mature audience.

- Strong written English, attention to detail, and reliable communication.

- Ability to work independently, track time, and flag missing information early.

- Experience with Metricool or willingness to learn quickly.

- Travel, tourism, hospitality, or lifestyle marketing experience is a plus.



**Our Brand Style**



Our voice is warm, conversational, confident, and occasionally playful. Content should help women picture themselves enjoying the experience while addressing real concerns such as finding travel companions, budgeting, and taking time for themselves.



Designs should follow our brand colors, fonts, and logo guidelines. No hearts or decorative Wingdings.



Trip dates, prices, inclusions, and payment details must match the information we provide. Accuracy is essential.



**How to Apply**



Please include:



1. A brief introduction and relevant experience.

2. Your requested hourly rate and total rate for 20 hours per month.

3. Three to five examples of your strongest graphics, captions, or short videos.

4. The tools you use for design, editing, and scheduling.

5. A short explanation of how you would support three daily posts within 20 monthly hours using templates and repurposed content.

6. Your availability and typical turnaround time.



Start your application with **“Travel Is Self Care”** so we know you read the full description.



We’re looking for someone who can become a dependable creative partner and help us consistently turn destination interest into travel inquiries.

title: YouTube Channel Manager
description:
Apply here: 
 



About List 25

List 25 is one of the original list-format channels on YouTube — 2.85 million subscribers, roughly 10 million views a month, and a catalog of thousands of videos that still pull views years after upload. We're a small, fully remote team (researchers, writers, editors, designers, and our on-camera host) publishing at a pace most channels can't touch — two videos a day on our flagship channel — and we're growing our family of channels. That's where you come in.



The Role

You will own one of our channels end to end. Not "help with" — own. Its ideas, its scripts, its production pipeline, and its growth numbers are yours. You'll work directly with leadership, get real data on everything you ship, and see your decisions show up in the analytics within days, not quarters.



This is a Remote Position



What You'll Do

- Run the channel day to day — own the publishing calendar and keep the pipeline moving at our cadence without quality slipping.

- Drive ideation — research trends, mining our own analytics and competitor channels for concepts, titles, and packaging (title + thumbnail) that earn the click.

- Read and approve scripts — you're the last line of defense before production: factual accuracy, pacing, hooks in the first 30 seconds, and retention structure.

- Manage the editors — assign work, give clear, fast feedback, hold deadlines, and keep output consistent with the channel's style.

- Own growth — watch CTR, retention, and engaged views like they're your own money; run packaging tests, kill what's not working, and double down on what is.

- Report what matters — a short weekly readout on what shipped, what the numbers say, and what you're changing next.



What Success Looks Like

- 30 days: the pipeline runs without you being chased; you've shipped your first self-ideated videos and can point to their numbers.

- 2 months: your channel's CTR and engaged views are trending up, and your ideation process is producing repeatable winners, not lucky ones.



What You Bring

- You have actually run a YouTube channel before — managed, produced, or grown one (yours or an employer's). We will ask for links and numbers.

- You think in packaging: you know a great topic with a weak title is a video nobody watches.

- You can read YouTube analytics fluently (CTR, retention curves, traffic sources) and turn them into decisions.

- You write and edit well — you can spot a weak hook, a slow middle, and a factual error in a script.

- You've managed creatives (editors/writers) and can give direct feedback without becoming a bottleneck.

- You're organized enough to run a daily publishing cadence and honest enough to flag problems early.

- Nice to have: experience with list/educational/entertainment formats, faceless channels, or multi-channel networks; thumbnail/design literacy; experience with AI-assisted research and scripting workflows.



Why This Role

- Real ownership of a channel with a real audience — your work is seen by millions.

- A team that already knows how to produce; your job is to lead it, not build it from zero.

- Fully remote, results over hours.

- Room to grow: high-performing managers get more channels and a bigger team.

title: Senior Accounts Payable Officer
description:
Who is Bare?



Bare is one of Australia’s fastest growing businesses, in one of the most traditional industries in the world — the funeral industry.



We exist to make end-of-life care accessible, affordable and transparent, changing the way Australians deal with death. For too long, the industry has delivered expensive, traditional, cookie-cutter services that don’t reflect how modern Australians want to say goodbye.



By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalised and affordable. In just five years, we’ve supported more than 40,000 families, become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (recognised for customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and built a team of 100+ passionate people.



And we’re just getting started.



As part of our continued growth, we’re looking for a Senior Accounts Payable Officer to join our finance team.



So, what’s the role?



We are looking for a detail-oriented and reliable Senior Accounts Payable Officer to join our finance team and support the day-to-day accounts payable operations of an Australian company.



The successful candidate will be responsible for accurately processing supplier invoices, maintaining vendor accounts, reconciling transactions, and ensuring payments are processed accurately and on time. The role will primarily use Dext and Xero will work closely with the Australian finance and operations teams.



This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong attention to detail who enjoys working with numbers, following and improving processes, and maintaining accurate financial records.



What you'll do

-Process and code supplier invoices accurately in Dext and Xero

-Organize scheduled payments and prepare them for approval

-Handle urgent payments through Airwallex 

-Respond to supplier queries and collaborate with the team on Slack

-Support month-end tasks and share ideas for improving how we work



What we're looking for

-3+ years in AP or a similar finance role

-Experience with Xero and Dext

-Strong attention to detail, with the ability to work quickly and accurately

-Reliable, organized, and takes ownership of their work

-Clear written English

-Bonus: experience improving or automating finance processes



What’s in it for you?



This isn’t your ordinary finance role, in your ordinary company. You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture where we succeed together. We offer autonomy, flexibility and real ownership. No two days are the same — and that’s exactly how we like it.



In addition, we offer:



-Strong opportunities for career growth and progression

-A high-performing and highly engaged team environment

-Autonomy and flexibility, including work-from-home options

-A competitive remuneration package

-The opportunity to help transform an industry and make a real human impact



The main reason you’ll join, however, is because you believe in what we’re building. You’re excited by growth. You want to help scale a business that is genuinely changing lives — and you want your finance expertise to be part of that journey.

title: # Cold Calling & Sales Role-Play Coach — 1-on-1 Training
description:
I am looking for an experienced **Sales Coach / Sales Trainer / Cold Calling Trainer** to work with me one-on-one.



I am **not looking for someone to make cold calls for me**. I am looking for someone who will **personally train and coach me so I become much better at cold calling and selling.**



The right person should be comfortable actively coaching me, challenging me, correcting me, and doing realistic role-plays with me.



## What I Want to Learn



I want to become confident and effective on the phone, including:



* How to start a cold call confidently

* How to create and deliver a strong pitch

* What exactly to say and how to say it

* How to sound confident, natural, and conversational

* How to avoid sounding nervous, robotic, or overly scripted

* How to ask good questions

* How to keep the prospect engaged

* How to identify the prospect's needs

* How to transition naturally into the offer

* How to ask for the appointment or sale

* How to handle rejection

* How to handle difficult prospects

* How to overcome common objections

* How to think on my feet when the prospect says something unexpected

* How to become more comfortable and confident through repeated practice



## I Want REAL Role-Playing



This is extremely important.



I want you to actually **play the role of the prospect** while I practice calling you.



For example, you might act like a prospect who says:



> "I'm not interested."



Then I respond.



You challenge me again.



You might say:



> "Just send me an
."



Or:



> "We already have someone."



Or:



> "How much does it cost?"



Or:



> "Where did you get my number?"



Or give me another realistic objection.



I want you to **challenge me instead of making the role-play easy.**



After the role-play, I want you to explain:



* What I did well

* What I did poorly

* Where I sounded uncertain

* What I should have said instead

* How I could improve my wording

* How I could sound more confident

* Where I talked too much

* Where I should have asked a question

* Where I should have pushed back

* How I could have moved the conversation toward an appointment or sale



Then I want to **do the role-play again** and apply your corrections.



## I Want a Coach Who Will Push Me



Please don't simply tell me that everything sounds good.



I want someone who will respectfully **challenge me and point out my weaknesses**.



If my pitch is weak, tell me.



If I sound nervous, tell me.



If I'm talking too much, stop me.



If I'm asking the wrong question, explain what I should ask.



If I'm avoiding asking for the sale, challenge me to actually ask.



The goal is for me to improve through **repetition, feedback, and realistic practice.**



## Help Me Build My Pitch



I would also like help developing and improving my actual sales pitch.



You should be able to help me:



1. Understand the product/service I'm selling

2. Create a strong opening

3. Develop the pitch

4. Create good discovery questions

5. Prepare responses to common objections

6. Practice the entire conversation

7. Adjust the script so it sounds natural rather than memorized

8. Practice until I can deliver it confidently



## Experience I'm Looking For



You should have significant experience in one or more of the following:



* Cold calling

* B2B sales

* B2C sales

* Sales training

* Sales coaching

* Sales management

* SDR/BDR training

* Business development

* Appointment setting

* Closing

* Objection handling

* Phone sales

* Sales role-playing

* Sales performance coaching



**Teaching/coaching ability is very important.**



Being a good salesperson alone is not enough. You need to be able to **teach another person how to sell.**



## Sample Video — VERY IMPORTANT



If you have a video showing yourself doing any of the following, please send it with your application:



* Sales coaching

* Cold-call training

* Role-playing a sales call

* Teaching someone how to sell

* Demonstrating a cold call

* Handling objections

* Training salespeople



It does **not** have to be a professionally produced video.



I mainly want to see **how you actually teach and coach.**



If you don't have an existing video, you may record a short sample explaining how you would coach someone through a cold call.



## Please Include Your Desired Rate



Please tell me **how much you are asking per hour** for this type of one-on-one coaching.



Do not simply write "negotiable."



Please provide your actual requested hourly rate.



## Please Answer These Questions



1. How many years of sales experience do you have?

2. How many years of sales training/coaching experience do you have?

3. Have you personally trained people to cold call?

4. Have you done live sales role-play with students or salespeople?

5. What types of products/services have you sold?

6. What type of sales were you involved in — B2B, B2C, high-ticket, appointment setting, closing, etc.?

7. How do you normally structure a one-on-one sales coaching session?

8. How do you teach someone to sound more confident on the phone?

9. How do you teach objection handling?

10. Are you comfortable challenging the student rather than simply giving encouragement?

11. Do you have a sample video? **Please provide the link.**

12. What is your desired hourly rate?



## Top 3 Skills



Please make sure your profile/application highlights these three skills:



**1. Cold Calling & Sales Training**



**2. Sales Role-Play & Objection Handling**



**3. Sales Pitch, Confidence & Communication Coaching**



I am looking for someone interested in **ongoing one-on-one coaching**, not just a one-time session.



Please apply with your experience, sample video if available, and desired hourly rate.

title: Marketing & Systems VA — GoHighLevel + Social Media
description:
About Us



We’re a small, growing medical aesthetics and wellness practice in Key West, Florida. We’re looking for a creative, tech-savvy Virtual Assistant to help strengthen our social media presence and execute the marketing systems that support our growth.



This is not primarily an administrative VA role. We need someone who enjoys both the creative and technical sides of marketing and can take an idea and turn it into a finished project.



We’re looking for a proactive, dependable, long-term team member who can grow with us.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN



Social Media & Content



* Help grow and improve our Instagram and
 presence

* Turn our raw photos, videos and ideas into polished content

* Create/edit Reels, posts, carousels and Stories

* Write captions and calls to action

* Schedule and publish content

* Maintain a content calendar

* Repurpose existing content

* Engage with followers and relevant local accounts

* Monitor routine comments and DMs and identify genuine patient inquiries for the owner

* Bring us content ideas rather than waiting to be told what to post



GoHighLevel, Funnels & Automation



* Build and maintain funnels and landing pages

* Create forms and lead capture systems

* Build and maintain workflows and automations

* Create
 and SMS marketing campaigns

* Manage pipelines, tags and Smart Lists

* Build patient reactivation and marketing campaigns

* Test and troubleshoot automations

* Track leads through the marketing funnel



You should understand how the pieces connect:



Social/Ads → Funnel → Lead → Automated Marketing → Booking → Revenue



Marketing Tracking & Reporting



Help maintain a simple marketing scorecard tracking leads, lead sources, bookings, show rate, conversion rate, ad spend, revenue, cost per lead, LTV and ROAS.



Help maintain accurate attribution using UTM parameters, Meta Pixel, GoHighLevel and conversion tracking.



You do not need to be a data analyst, but you should be comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets and notice when something looks wrong.



Meta /
 & Instagram Ads



Meta Ads Manager experience is a strong plus. You may assist with uploading creative, monitoring campaigns and spend, reviewing results and flagging issues.



Advanced paid-ad strategy is not required, but you should understand how social content, ads, funnels and tracking work together.



YOU MUST HAVE



* Excellent written AND spoken English

* Hands-on GoHighLevel experience — you have actually built workflows, automations, funnels or pipelines

* Social media content creation/management experience

* Short-form video editing experience using CapCut or similar

* Canva experience and good visual judgment

* Comfort with Google Sheets/Excel and marketing metrics

* Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT

* Reliable internet

* Ability to communicate during at least some U.S. Eastern Time hours

* Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently



NICE TO HAVE



Experience with Meta Ads Manager, Meta Pixel, UTMs/conversion tracking, medical aesthetics, medspas, beauty, wellness or healthcare marketing.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



We’re not looking for someone who needs a detailed task list every morning. We want someone who can learn our business, understand our goals, bring ideas to us and consistently move projects forward.



Patient scheduling/calendar management and clinical communication are not part of this position.



POSITION DETAILS



Part-time, long-term position.



Starting compensation approximately $400 USD/month, depending on experience.



This is a deliverables-focused role. We care more about consistent, high-quality work and completed responsibilities than monitoring every minute worked.



There will be an initial review period with room for increased responsibility and compensation as the role grows.



HOW TO APPLY



Please follow these instructions carefully:



1. Tell us briefly about yourself and why this position interests you.

2. Send examples of social media content/accounts you have managed and Reels you have edited.

3. Tell us specifically what you have built inside GoHighLevel.

4. Send an example of a funnel or landing page you have built, if available.

5. Tell us about any experience with Meta Ads Manager, Pixel, UTMs or conversion tracking.

6. List the AI and marketing tools you regularly use.

7. Send a 60–90 second video in English introducing yourself and telling us about one GoHighLevel workflow, funnel or automation you personally built.

“GHL Systems — [Your First Name]”

title: Social Media Content Creator + Video Editor | Education Brand | Must Understand Culture
description:
Social Media Content Creator + Video Editor | Education Brand | Must Understand Culture



I’m looking for someone who understands social media, but more importantly, understands **people, culture, humor, and what makes someone stop scrolling.**



This is NOT a job for someone who wants to make generic Canva graphics, add trending audio to random clips, and call it a content strategy.



I can do that myself.



I’m the founder of Legrand Prep, an education company based in New York. My work sits at the intersection of education, test prep, parenting, culture, Black excellence, humor, and educational thought leadership.



You probably do not know my niche yet.



**That’s okay.**



What matters is whether you know how to research a niche, study an audience, understand a creator’s voice, recognize cultural conversations, and turn raw ideas into content people actually want to watch.



### Who I’m looking for



I want someone who has their ear to the ground.



You should genuinely consume social media and understand why certain creators, edits, hooks, memes, conversations, sounds, and formats are taking off.



You should understand that being “on trend” does NOT mean blindly copying trends.



I especially want someone who understands or is genuinely interested in Black American and urban culture, education, parenting, Gen Z, and the conversations happening around those communities. You do not need to be American or already know everything about my audience. You DO need to be curious enough to research what you don’t know rather than expecting me to explain every cultural reference to you.



If I mention something you don’t understand, I want your instinct to be:



**“Let me go figure out what she’s talking about.”**



Not:



**“Can you explain exactly what you want me to do?”**



I do not have time to micromanage.



### What you may be doing



You’ll work with raw videos, Zoom recordings, educational content, talking-head videos, student success stories, commentary, and ideas that I send you.



Your job may include:



• Finding the strongest moments in longer videos and turning them into compelling short-form content  

• Editing Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, and other video content  

• Writing strong hooks and on-screen text  

• Creating captions that actually sound like ME  

• Researching trends, conversations, creators, competitors, and cultural moments  

• Finding creative ways to package educational ideas so they don’t LOOK like boring educational content  

• Repurposing one piece of content into several useful pieces  

• Bringing ME ideas instead of waiting for me to invent everything  

• Looking at analytics and learning what our audience responds to  

• Helping develop a recognizable visual and editorial style for the brand



You do not have to know everything on day one. I care much more about taste, judgment, curiosity, creativity, initiative, and your ability to learn.



### You will probably love this role if…



You’re the person who sends your friends a Reel and says, “THIS EDITING.”



You notice when a creator changes the first three seconds of their videos.



You can tell when a brand is trying way too hard to sound young.



You understand why technically “good” content can still be boring.



You know that beautiful does not automatically mean interesting.



You understand humor and timing.



You’re willing to research communities and cultural references you don’t already understand.



You can watch a 7-minute video and identify the 45 seconds that would make somebody say, **“WAIT. She has a point.”**



And you have opinions.



I want someone who can respectfully tell me:



**“I don't think we should post it like that. I think THIS is the stronger hook.”**



### Please DO NOT apply if…



Your portfolio is mostly generic Canva quote graphics.



You need extremely detailed instructions for every piece of content.



You copy and paste AI-generated captions without making them sound human.



You think every business post needs emojis, inspirational music, and phrases like “unlock your potential.”



You wait for your boss to tell you what is trending.



You are uncomfortable researching Black American culture or content created primarily for Black parents, students, and families.



Or you’re looking for a job where you can simply complete a checklist without thinking creatively.



### How to apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction telling me who you are and WHY this particular job caught your attention.



2. Links to **3 social media creators you genuinely enjoy following.** They do NOT need to be education creators. Tell me in one or two sentences what each creator does particularly well.



3. Tell me your **favorite quote** and why you like it.



4. Send me **ONE piece of social media content you think is exceptionally well done** and tell me specifically why it works. I care about your analysis more than whether I personally like the content.



5. Send links to your portfolio or 2–3 examples of short-form videos/content you personally created.



6. Start your application with the words **“HARD TO FOOL.”**



Yes, that instruction is intentional.



If your application does not begin with those three words, I will not review it.



I’m looking for someone who pays attention.



### One last thing



Please don't send me a generic cover letter.



I would rather read five sentences that actually sound like YOU than five paragraphs generated by AI about how “thrilled” you are to contribute to our “dynamic and innovative organization.”



I’m hiring a creative human.



I want to meet one.

A typical project might be an online workshop launch. I would own the offer, teaching, videos, and much of the copy. You would help turn the launch plain brain dump into an operational system, establish priorities and deadlines, build out the course and marketing infrastructure, identify what you need from me and when, implement the systems, test the customer journey, and keep us moving toward launch without me holding every detail in my head.

 marketing and nurture sequences

title: Amazon Listings and Daily Operations (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
PAY AND HOURS - READ THIS FIRST



$2.50 to $3.00 an hour. Everyone starts in that range, whatever their experience. $3.00 is the ceiling for a new person and I do not move on it later, so please do not apply planning to negotiate.



Full time, eight hours a day, from day one - including the first month, which is a trial for both of us at the same rate.



At full time that is roughly $430 to $520 a month.



I know that is low. I would rather you close this now than after you have written to me.



WHAT THIS JOB IS



I sell private-label products on Amazon - 34 seller accounts, around 246 listings, across the US, UK, Canada and Australia. I am in Sydney. You work Philippine hours that overlap with mine.



The work:



- Writing and maintaining listings to a written spec. Titles, Item Highlights, bullets, descriptions, backend search terms.

- Keyword research that feeds into that copy.

- Coupons, deals and promotions - booking them, tracking them, cancelling them on time.

- Listing problems: suppressions, policy warnings, category errors, flat file uploads, appeals.

- Daily checks on account health and policy notifications.



Most days are a queue of small tasks done exactly the same way. If that sounds dull, it will be, and you should not apply.



THIS IS NOT A PPC JOB



I am hiring an advertising specialist separately. You do not need to have run campaigns and I am not asking for ad screenshots.



You will still see Campaign Manager - enough to read a search term report and pull keywords out of it - but nobody is going to ask you to set a bid.



STRICT SOP COMPLIANCE



Everything runs from written procedures. When a procedure does not cover your case, you stop and ask. You do not fill the gap with your own judgement, even when your judgement is right. Across 34 accounts, one good improvisation is fine and the tenth is expensive.



I will send you the procedures. Following them exactly is most of the job.



WHAT YOU MUST HAVE



- Two years actually working inside Seller Central. Not two years around Amazon - two years with the login in your hand.



- Listings you built or rewrote yourself, and at least two live ASINs I can open right now. Not a portfolio folder. Not a Drive link. Not a listing you follow. Ones you worked on.



- Enough English to write listing copy that reads naturally.



- A stable connection and a quiet eight hours.



NICE, NOT REQUIRED



Flat files, A+ Content, image or video work, Google and Meta ads, influencer outreach. Say so if you have it. It will not get you the job on its own and its absence will not lose it.



HOW TO APPLY



Put the word DINGO at the top of your reply, then answer these seven questions.



Short answers are fine. Answers I can check are worth more than answers that sound good.



Write them yourself. If your reply arrives with bracketed placeholder text still in it - [YOUR NUMBER HERE], [INSERT ASIN] - I will stop reading there. Three people did that last round. Reading your own work before you send it is a large part of this job.



1. Two live ASINs you have personally worked on, and what you did to each one. Links I can open right now.



If confidentiality stops you, say so and send two ASINs you did not work on instead, with what you would change about each. I will take that answer. I will not take "I cannot show you anything."



2. How many years have you personally worked inside Seller Central, and what do you do in there in a normal week?



3. Walk me through booking a Lightning Deal or a coupon, from where you click to what you check afterwards.



4. Tell me about one suppressed listing or policy warning you personally handled. What was wrong, what did you do in Seller Central, and how long did it take?



5. Two real products in the same category:



A - $9.99, and the box says the roll is 1.5 m x 4 cm

B - $12.99, and the box says the roll is 9 m x 4 cm



Before you write a single word of copy for A, what do you work out, and what does it tell you?



6. In one week, how many listings can you write to a written spec without the quality dropping? Give me a number, and tell me what slows you down.



7. Your rate, and when you could start.



BONUS QUESTION



Open any Amazon product that is currently #1 in its category. Tell me three things you would change and why.



You are allowed to tell me it is already good and should be left alone. I am not testing whether you can find faults. I am testing whether your reasons hold up.



HOW I WORK



I answer. If you do the work, you get a real reply, not silence.



There is one test task after the application. It is ninety minutes and it is unpaid. I am telling you now rather than after you have written to me. It is the only unpaid thing I will ask for, I will not extend it, and I will not change the terms once you have started.



Paid work is paid on time. If I change my mind about something, I will tell you why.

title: Paid Media Team Lead
description:
Paid Media Team Lead



Location: Philippines, Remote

Schedule: Full time, Monday through Friday, U.S. Eastern business hours

Compensation: $3,500 USD per month



About the Role:



Workspark is hiring an experienced Paid Media Team Lead to join the paid media team of an established U.S. digital marketing agency.



This is a great opportunity for someone who has built strong paid search expertise and is ready to combine that experience with team leadership, client strategy, and meaningful ownership.



You will lead a team of three paid media professionals while also working directly with clients and staying close enough to the platforms to jump in when needed.



This is not a role where you simply review reports or manage from a distance. You will help shape strategy, understand what is driving performance, guide your team, and help clients make smarter decisions with their media investment.



What You Will Do:



• Lead, coach, and support a team of three paid media professionals

• Hold regular 1:1s, provide feedback, help prioritize workloads, and support the team’s development

• Lead paid media strategy for assigned client accounts

• Lead client conversations, present performance and recommendations, and handle more complex questions or escalations

• Stay hands on with Google Ads and Microsoft Ads when needed

• Work across Paid Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen, YouTube, and Display

• Analyze campaign performance and turn the data into clear recommendations and next steps

• Lead forecasting, budget planning, pacing, and performance planning

• Manage accounts with more than $1 million in annual advertising spend

• Use Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, attribution, and performance reporting to understand what is working and where opportunities exist

• Use AI tools to support analysis, reporting, forecasting, and strategic planning

• Work closely with other teams across the agency to help clients get stronger results



What We Are Looking For:



• 5+ years of hands on paid search experience

• Digital marketing agency experience

• Strong, recent experience with both Google Ads and Microsoft Ads

• Experience managing annual advertising budgets of $1 million or more

• Experience leading, mentoring, or managing paid media professionals

• Strong forecasting, budgeting, and performance planning experience

• Experience leading client conversations and presenting recommendations clearly

• Strong understanding of Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, attribution, and measurement

• Strong analytical skills and confidence working in Excel and Google Sheets

• Experience turning campaign performance data into meaningful business recommendations

• Experience using AI tools to support paid media work

• Strong organization and the ability to manage multiple accounts, priorities, and deadlines

• Excellent spoken and written English

• Comfortable working full time during U.S. Eastern business hours



You May Be a Great Fit If:



You enjoy digging into the numbers and understanding why performance is changing, not just reporting what happened.



You like helping other paid media professionals become better at what they do.



You are comfortable moving between client conversations, strategy, leadership, and hands on campaign work.



And even though you have grown into leadership, you still understand the platforms well enough to roll up your sleeves when the team needs you.



If that sounds like the kind of work you have already been doing and you are ready to take on more ownership with a U.S. agency, we would love to hear from you.



What Workspark Provides:



• $3,500 USD monthly compensation

• Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave after probation

• Regular Workspark employee check ins and support

• Full time work directly with an established U.S. digital marketing agency

• The opportunity to lead an experienced paid media team while continuing to grow your strategic and client leadership experience

Please submit:

title: lead researcher
description:
Pay: $2/hour + Performance Bonuses

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8 hours per day (40 hours/week)

Position: Full-Time Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Product Sourcing VA



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED.

will need 60 second video of you talking head video to show me you really want the job an can follow orders

Do NOT apply if you have never sourced profitable products for Amazon FBA before. I am specifically looking for someone who already understands Amazon product sourcing and can work independently.



You should already know how to analyze Amazon listings, research suppliers, verify websites, check sellers and competition, calculate profit, and determine whether a product is actually worth purchasing.



YOUR MAIN JOB



You must provide 5 VALID ASINs per day.



That equals 25 valid ASINs per week.



Finding 5 random products does NOT count. Products must meet ALL of my requirements and pass my review.



If some of your daily ASINs are rejected, you have until the end of the week/payday to replace them and reach the required 25 valid ASINs.



25 approved ASINs per week is the minimum requirement — not just 25 submissions.



BONUSES 💰



I reward VAs who consistently provide good leads and help me grow the business.



You can earn additional bonuses for:



Consistently finding valid ASINs: If your leads regularly pass my review and meet all requirements, you can receive performance bonuses.



More than 25 approved ASINs: If you finish your required 25 valid ASINs early and continue finding additional approved products, you can receive a bonus for exceeding your weekly target.



Finding profitable Amazon seller storefronts: If you discover a strong Online Arbitrage seller storefront that I can use for further product research, submit the storefront to me. If I review it and approve it as a good sourcing opportunity, you can receive a bonus.



High-quality sourcing: VAs who consistently find products that I actually purchase and successfully sell will have opportunities for additional bonuses and higher pay over time.



Quality still matters. Adding random ASINs just to go above 25 will NOT earn a bonus. Extra ASINs must meet the same requirements as your normal submissions and pass my review.



PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS



Every product you submit must:



Be a brand I am already approved/ungated to sell



Make at least $2 profit per unit



Have at least 50 estimated sales per month



NOT be a generic brand



Have realistic competition where I can actually get sales



Have enough room for me to enter the listing without immediately destroying the price



Come from a REAL, TRUSTWORTHY SOURCE



Be in stock and actually available to purchase



Match the EXACT Amazon product/variation



Include the correct source link



Include the correct Amazon ASIN/listing



Not already have been submitted by another VA on my team



ROI is NOT my main requirement. I care more about actual dollar profit, sales volume, competition, and whether I can realistically sell the inventory.



QUANTITY MATTERS



Do NOT submit deals that only become profitable when purchasing an unrealistic quantity.



Example:



If a product only meets my requirements when buying 25 units, but the Amazon listing only sells around 50 units per month and has 20 competing sellers, I am obviously not going to purchase 25 units.



Use common sense.



Look at:



Monthly sales + number of sellers + competition + minimum purchase quantity.



The deal needs to make sense for MY business, not just look profitable on a spreadsheet.



SOURCE VERIFICATION IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



You MUST verify every website before submitting it.



I recently had a VA provide a fake website that looked like a major retailer. A purchase was made from the website and the card information was compromised.



That cannot happen again.



Before submitting ANY unfamiliar website, verify that it is legitimate.



Do NOT submit:



Fake retailer websites



Scam websites



Copycat websites



Suspicious Shopify stores



Random websites with no established reputation



Sources you have not properly researched



A retailer/distributor different from the one you put in the spreadsheet



If you are unsure whether a source is legitimate, DO NOT SUBMIT IT. Ask me first.



QUALITY > RANDOM LEADS



I would rather receive 5 strong ASINs than 20 bad ones.



Do not fill the spreadsheet just to hit your number.



Repeatedly submitting products that clearly violate the requirements will result in termination.



YOU SHOULD ALREADY KNOW



You should have previous experience with:



Amazon Seller Central



Amazon FBA



Online Arbitrage



Product sourcing



Keepa



SellerAmp SAS or similar tools



Buy Box analysis



Sales rank / estimated monthly sales



Amazon fees



Profit calculations



Seller/competition analysis



Variation matching



Source verification



Checking whether Amazon is on the listing



Identifying dangerous price drops or listings with too much competition



Amazon seller storefront sourcing / storefront stalking



You should NOT need me to teach you the basics of Amazon sourcing.



HOURS



Monday–Friday

8 hours per day

40 hours per week



This is a long-term position for the right person.



Starting pay is $2/hour, but strong performance can earn you bonuses and opportunities for increased pay.



The better the products you find and the more value you bring to the business, the more opportunity you have to earn.



HOW TO APPLY



Do NOT send me a generic copy-and-paste application.



Start your application with:



“I HAVE AMAZON SOURCING EXPERIENCE”



Then answer these questions:



How long have you been sourcing products for Amazon?



Have you done Online Arbitrage before?



What sourcing tools have you used?



Do you know how to use Keepa? Explain what you normally check on a Keepa chart.



Do you know how to use SellerAmp SAS?



How do you determine whether there are too many sellers on a listing?



How do you verify that a sourcing website is legitimate?



How do you determine how many units of a product you would recommend buying?



What is the difference between profit and ROI?



Have you used Amazon seller storefronts to find additional profitable products? Explain your process.



Send an example of an Amazon sourcing spreadsheet you have worked with before, with any confidential client information removed.



FINAL TEST: Include one example ASIN + source link that you believe would be worth researching for Online Arbitrage. Briefly explain why you chose it.



If you cannot answer these questions, please do not apply.



I am looking for someone who already knows what they are doing, pays attention to details, follows instructions, verifies their sources, and can consistently find products that I can actually buy and sell.

title: Short-Form Video Editor: Entertainment Content (Long-Term)
description:
If you're tired of one-off gigs and clients who disappear after three videos, this this is for you. It's steady, ongoing work with the same clients every week.



We're a content agency. We work with entertainers and creators, we take their raw footage and turn it into short clips for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and
. We put out
clips a month across our roster.



You'll get your own set of clients and own their clips. Our editors stay with us long-term and their rosters grow over time.



ABOUT THE STYLE



You get full creative freedom. We don't have one house style you have to copy. We want our clients to look different from each other, not all cut from the same template. So you bring your own touch and adapt it to the clients you work with.



What isn't flexible: captions have to be accurate, timing has to be tight, and due dates get hit. Get those right and the creative side is yours.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Edit clips for your assigned clients: captions, graphics, hooks, cuts

- Develop a look that suits each client you work with

- Hit your weekly due dates

- Get clips right the first time. Rework costs you time and us the posting schedule

- Be available for two short calls and one team meeting a week, and daily communication on slack while working.



YOU'RE A FIT IF

- You can edit short-form social video (CapCut, Premiere etc) - We supply you with CapCut Pro

- Your English is strong enough to caption fast, casual US speech accurately, slang, accents and people talking over each other. This is the most important skill in the role

- You're detail-focused. Caption typos and timing slips matter more here than anything else

- You can work at volume without quality dropping

- You can commit to a consistent weekly schedule



EQUIPMENT

- You need a computer that handles video work, reliable internet, and storage space for raw footage. We send a lot of it and you'll be holding it while you work. An external hard drive is the normal setup, but plenty of free space on your computer works too.



PAY: Per approved clip:

- $2.00 for your first 50 clips

- $2.50 for the next 50

- $3.00 after that

Plus a $15/week base fee for availability: calls, team meetings, Slack, and going through training material.



Once you're up to speed with a full client roster, that works out to roughly $1,000/month plus the base. Our current editors are at that level.



HOW TO APPLY

- Put "CLIPMAKER" in your subject line.



Send:

- Your portfolio, or 2–3 short-form clips you've edited (links, not attachments)

- Your weekly availability in hours and your time zone

- Your storage setup, external drive size and free space, or free space on your computer



Shortlisted applicants get a short test: one raw set, one clip, cut to timestamps we provide. Every applicant gets the same footage so we can compare fairly.



Independent contractor, remote.

title: Fitness Coaching Brand (Instagram) - Carousel Designer
description:
Fitness carousel experience required.



Type: Part-time / Freelance, ongoing

Volume: 4 carousels per week (about 16 per month)

Rate: $10–$12 per finished carousel (paid test first, rate review after 90 days)

Turnaround: 48 hours per carousel



Read This First



This role is only for designers who already make Instagram carousels for fitness creators or coaches. If your portfolio doesn't include fitness, nutrition, or training carousels, please don't apply.



About Me



I run a 1:1 online coaching business helping men 25–45 get lean, build structure, stay consistent, and get below 15% body fat.



I handle the ideas, slide copy, photos, and strategy. You turn it into a carousel people want to save, share, and send to a friend.



Reference Carousels



These are style references. Don't copy them, but match that level of quality.



[Pinned example 1: "The Weapon Split"] is a bold, branded series. One template stays consistent across all 8 slides, with clean photo cutouts, icons, and short lists you can scan in two seconds. 
 



[Pinned example 2: "The Ultimate Scriptwriting Format"] is dark and minimal. It opens with a strong hook slide, puts one idea on each slide, and ends with a comment-keyword CTA.





What You'll Design



Weekly plans and splits. Examples: a 7-day training split, a day of eating, a fat-loss week.

Rankings and tier lists. Examples: best and worst foods for fat loss, top high-protein snacks.

Frameworks and step-by-step breakdowns. Examples: how to get to 12% body fat, why you're not losing weight.

Mistakes, myths, and mindset posts.

Lead magnet CTA slides. Example: "Comment SYSTEMS and I'll send you the guide." I write the CTA; you make it impossible to miss.



Every carousel has one job: give so much value that people save it, share it, and swipe to the last slide.



The Style

Hook slide

Product pages

Landing pages

Offer pages

Upsells

Bundles

Checkout flows

Example:



High CPM?

Look at audience, account, creative and market.



Good CPM but bad CTR?

The creative or hook may be weak.



Good CTR but bad conversion rate?

Check the landing page, product, offer and funnel.



Good conversion rate but bad ROAS?

Analyze CPA, AOV, pricing, margins and campaign structure.

Competitor ads

Competitor stores

Landing pages

Offers

Hooks

Pricing

Bundles

Customer problems

New creative angles

Fast

Independent

Data-driven

Creative

Organized

Comfortable testing aggressively

Good communicators

Able to take ownership

Focused on results rather than activity

You depend on other people for every creative

You only follow instructions without giving ideas

You do not analyze your own numbers

You wait several days before reacting to poor performance

You must be comfortable both inside **Meta Ads Manager** and inside video editing software.



This is an important requirement.



We do not want a Media Buyer who depends on another person for every creative, and we do not want a video editor who does not understand advertising performance.



## Your Role



Your main responsibility will be to help us test and scale e-commerce products using
 and Instagram Ads.



A large part of your daily work will involve creating new advertising creatives.



You will research:



* Competitor advertisements

* Product demonstrations

* UGC content

* Customer reviews

* Product benefits

* Hooks

* Creative angles

* Existing winning advertisements



You will then turn this material into new e-commerce ads.



This includes:



* Video editing

* Strong opening hooks

* Text overlays

* Subtitles

* Voiceovers

* Product benefits

* Different calls to action

* Different creative angles

* Multiple variations of each ad



You should be able to create ads quickly while still understanding the purpose behind each creative.



Every creative should be designed to improve performance.



## Media Buying



You will personally launch and manage
 and Instagram campaigns.



Your daily work may include:



* Launching new product tests

* Launching new creatives

* Monitoring campaign performance

* Comparing creatives

* Identifying winning ads

* Stopping poor performers

* Optimizing campaigns

* Scaling successful campaigns

* Testing new angles

* Testing new offers

* Managing multiple products and stores



You should be able to work independently without needing instructions for every small campaign decision.



## Understanding KPIs



We place a lot of importance on KPI knowledge.



You must understand:



* CPA

* ROAS

* CTR

* CPC

* CPM

* Conversion Rate

* AOV

* Frequency

* Break-Even CPA

* Break-Even ROAS



More importantly, you should understand **what these numbers mean together.**



You should be able to recognize situations such as:



A low CTR may indicate a weak creative or hook.



A good CTR with poor sales may indicate a problem with the offer, product page, or conversion rate.



A high CPM does not automatically mean an ad is bad if the CPA and profitability are still strong.



A winning creative should lead to new variations, hooks, and angles being tested.



We are looking for someone who thinks this way naturally.



## Creative Skills



You should be comfortable creating ads yourself using tools such as:



* CapCut

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* Canva

* After Effects

* Other similar editing software



You should have a good understanding of **direct-response e-commerce advertising**, not only traditional video editing.



Your job is not to make cinematic videos.



Your job is to make videos that **sell products.**

A smaller part of the role may involve adjusting landing pages or product pages.



We will usually provide existing templates or examples.



You may occasionally:



* Change images and videos

* Update product text

* Change prices or offers

* Check links and buttons

* Make simple page adjustments

* Check mobile and desktop layouts



Advanced web development is not required.



Basic Shopify, Wix, or similar experience is enough.

You should already have:



* E-commerce
 Ads experience

* Physical product advertising experience

* Meta Ads Manager experience

* Creative testing experience

* Video editing experience

* Strong KPI knowledge

* Experience analyzing campaign performance

* Experience optimizing campaigns

* Experience scaling profitable campaigns

* Strong competitor research skills

* Good English communication

* Good organization and reliability



Experience with **lead generation only is not enough for this position.**



We specifically want someone who has worked with **e-commerce sales campaigns and understands purchase-focused advertising.**



## Compensation & Growth



* **Starting rate: $6 USD/hour**

* Weekly payments

* Performance bonuses

* Additional commissions possible

* Salary increases based on performance

* Fully remote

* Long-term position



We want someone who can stay with the team long-term.



Strong performers can eventually take on more responsibility, help train junior staff, and move into a Team Lead position.



We value people who can combine:



**Good Creatives + Good Media Buying + Good KPI Decisions**



If you understand all three, this role should be a strong fit.

HOW TO APPLY – PLEASE READ CAREFULLY

• Are you comfortable working Canadian business hours?

• When would you be available to start?

MULTIPLE BUSINESSES

title: **Amazon KDP Book Formatter & Print Layout Designer | 25-Book Project**
description:
Peak Media World is looking for an experienced and detail-oriented **Book Formatter / Print Layout Designer** for a temporary publishing project.



This is **project-based freelance work, not a permanent position**.



We are preparing a series of approximately **25 German-language paperback books** for publication through Amazon KDP. The manuscripts and core content are already being created. We are looking for someone who can turn completed manuscripts into professional, consistent, print-ready books.



### What you will work on



You will help us create and maintain one professional production system for the full book series, including:



- interior book formatting and page layout

- consistent headings, typography and spacing

- large, highly readable text for an older target audience

- correct page breaks and clean puzzle layouts

- sufficient writing space where required

- placement and formatting of illustrations

- page numbering and table of contents where applicable

- preparation of print-ready interior PDFs

- paperback cover preparation

- front cover, back cover and spine layout

- correct trim size, margins and bleed

- adjustment of spine width according to final page count

- KDP-ready export and final file check

- editable source files

- consistent file naming and version management



We will first create a **Golden Master / master template** using one or two representative books. Once approved, that production standard will be used across the remaining titles.



### What we are looking for



Ideally, you already have hands-on experience with:



- Amazon KDP paperback production

- book formatting / interior layout

- print-ready PDF preparation

- paperback cover and spine design

- typography and readable page design

- Canva, Adobe InDesign, Affinity Publisher, Adobe Photoshop or comparable tools

- working accurately from an existing manuscript and detailed production brief

- organizing multiple files and versions without confusion



**Very important:** We are not primarily looking for a writer, social media manager or general virtual assistant. The main task is **book production and print layout**.



However, you do **not** need to know every tool or every part of our workflow already.



If you are already strong in professional book or print layout but are missing one smaller KDP-specific skill, please still apply. We value people who learn quickly, follow instructions carefully and can adapt to a clear production system.



### Nice to have



These skills are helpful but not mandatory:



- experience with puzzle books, activity books or large-print books

- basic image editing

- AI-assisted image or content workflows

- experience creating reusable templates

- experience documenting workflows or SOPs

- knowledge of Amazon publishing or e-commerce

- experience handling a multi-book series



### Additional preferred skill – YouTube publishing support



Experience with **YouTube Studio** is a plus, especially if you have handled tasks such as:



- uploading and scheduling videos

- adding titles and descriptions

- uploading thumbnails

- organizing playlists

- adding end screens

- adding or checking subtitles

- reviewing publishing settings before release

- performing final publication checks



This is **not the main focus of the project**, but it may become part of the assignment if needed.



### Project period and availability



This is a **temporary project expected to run approximately 2–3 weeks**.



We prefer someone who can commit approximately **30–40 hours per week during the project**, although a strong candidate with slightly lower availability may still be considered.



The project may lead to future publishing assignments, but **no ongoing employment is promised or required**.



### Budget



**USD equivalent of approximately EUR 4–5 per hour**, depending on experience and demonstrated production ability.



Please apply only if this range is acceptable to you.



### How we work



We use clear briefs, structured folders, defined production stages and documented standards.



We value:



- accuracy

- reliability

- independent thinking

- clear communication

- careful quality control

- asking when something is genuinely unclear rather than guessing

- willingness to learn missing small skills



Quality matters more to us than rushing.



### Application questions



Please answer **all questions briefly and directly**.



**1.** Have you personally formatted a paperback or print book before? Please describe what you did.



**2.** Have you prepared a book specifically for Amazon KDP? If yes, what parts did you handle yourself?



**3.** Which tools do you use for book layout and cover design?  

Examples: Canva, InDesign, Affinity Publisher, Photoshop or others.



**4.** Please briefly explain the difference between **trim size, margins and bleed** in a paperback book.



**5.** Have you created a paperback cover that included a **spine**? If yes, how did you determine the correct spine width?



**6.** Please provide at least **one example, screenshot or portfolio sample of a book interior, print layout or paperback cover that you personally created**.



If you cannot provide a sample because of client confidentiality, please explain exactly what type of work you completed.



**7.** Imagine you receive 25 finished manuscripts that should all follow the same visual series standard. How would you organize the files and versions so that nothing gets mixed up?



**8.** If you are given a task you have not done before—for example, one specific KDP export requirement—what would you normally do?



**9.** How many hours per week can you commit during the next 2–3 weeks?



**10.** What hourly rate do you expect for this temporary project?



**11.** Have you worked with YouTube Studio before? If yes, which publishing tasks have you handled yourself?



**12.** 12. Are you comfortable working with both German and English manuscripts if the translated/localized content is provided to you?



Possible follow-up project – English editions

After completion of the German series, we may produce localized English editions of the same books. Translation/localization will be prepared separately; however, the selected freelancer may be asked to format and prepare the English editions for KDP using the established series templates. Good written English and the ability to work accurately with English-language manuscripts are therefore an advantage.



Please start your application with the words:



**RIDDLE PEAK**



This helps us confirm that you read the full job description.



Thank you. We look forward to reviewing your work.



**Peak Media World**

title: Direct Response Video Editor | Graphics, Captions & Typography
description:
We’re looking for a high level video editor who knows how to take raw footage and turn it into polished, engaging content that keeps people watching.



Most of the videos we produce are between 2 and 5 minutes long.



These are longer form performance advertisements, talking head videos and direct response creatives where pacing and retention matter from the first second to the final CTA.



We need someone who understands that strong editing is more than cutting out pauses.



You should know how to use pacing, graphics, captions, typography, B roll, sound design and visual changes to keep a 2 to 5 minute video engaging without making it feel chaotic or overedited.



We’re especially interested in editors with a strong eye for graphic design and typography.



If your work feels clean, intentional and visually polished, we want to see it.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



* Edit 2 to 5 minute direct response and performance videos

* Edit talking head and scripted footage

* Clean up mistakes, pauses and unnecessary sections

* Create strong pacing and maintain retention throughout the entire video

* Design and animate on screen graphics

* Create clean, engaging captions

* Use typography creatively to emphasize important ideas

* Add B roll and supporting visuals

* Create callouts, charts, screenshots and visual explanations

* Use punch ins, reframing and camera changes strategically

* Add music and sound design where appropriate

* Clean and balance audio

* Color correct footage

* Follow established branding while still bringing your own creative ideas

* Take feedback and turn revisions around efficiently



YOU’RE PROBABLY A GREAT FIT IF...



* You have experience editing videos in the 2 to 5 minute range

* You understand pacing, attention and viewer retention

* You know how to keep a video visually engaging beyond the first 30 seconds

* Your graphics look professionally designed and not like default templates

* You have a strong eye for typography, spacing, hierarchy and composition

* You know when captions should be subtle and when they should become part of the visual storytelling

* You understand how to use B roll without throwing random stock footage over every sentence

* You can create motion graphics that make ideas easier to understand

* You notice small details in timing, audio, alignment and animation

* You’re comfortable working in Adobe Premiere Pro

* Experience with After Effects is a major plus

* You can follow creative direction without needing every edit spelled out for you

* You’re organized and can manage projects with multiple assets, graphics and revisions

* You’re receptive to feedback and constantly trying to improve your work



WHAT WE CARE ABOUT



We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to operate editing software.



We care about taste.



We care about pacing.



We care about retention.



We care about whether your graphics actually improve the video.



We care about whether your typography looks intentional.



We care about whether you know when to add something visually and when to let the footage breathe.



A great editor understands how all of those decisions work together to keep someone watching for the full 2 to 5 minutes.



WORKING WITH OUR TEAM



You’ll work alongside our creative and marketing team on a variety of performance driven video projects.



We move quickly, communicate directly and expect editors to take ownership of their work.



You’ll receive footage, scripts, brand assets and creative direction when needed, but we also want someone who can look at a section of a video and come up with a stronger visual solution on their own.



We want editors who are interested in becoming significantly better at their craft and want to grow with a team producing a high volume of creative.



PAID EDITING TEST



Final candidates will complete a paid editing test.



We’ll provide the footage and creative direction.



The purpose of the test is to see how you approach:



* Pacing

* Viewer retention

* Graphics

* Captions

* Typography

* B roll

* Sound design

* Visual storytelling

* Overall polish



We want to see your creative judgment, not just whether you can follow instructions.



TO APPLY



Please send us:



* Your portfolio

* Your 2 to 3 BEST examples of videos between approximately 2 and 5 minutes that you personally edited

* Links directly to the videos whenever possible

* Examples that showcase strong graphics, captions and typography

* A short explanation of exactly what you handled on each project

* The editing software you primarily use

* Your availability during US business hours



Please prioritize examples that show you can maintain strong pacing and visual interest for several minutes.



Short form reels and TikToks are fine to include as additional work, but we specifically want to see examples that demonstrate your ability to edit longer 2 to 5 minute videos.



Include the word LONGFORM somewhere in your application so we know you read the entire posting.

title: Virtual Assistant & Social Media Content Coordinator
description:
# Virtual Assistant & Social Media Content Coordinator



**Company:** Mindful Beginnings, LLC  

**Position:** Part-Time Virtual Assistant / Social Media & Content Coordinator

 & Newsletter Support

I am not looking for someone who simply waits for a list of tasks every day.



I would love to work with someone who can eventually understand the Mindful Beginnings brand well enough to say:



“Here are three content ideas for this week.”
