“I noticed we don't have a process for this, so I drafted an SOP.”



“This video could also work as a YouTube Short.”



“This topic would make a great newsletter.”



I will provide the clinical expertise, ideas, stories, and direction. I want someone who can help organize, package, edit, publish, and maximize that content.



## To Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your experience with social media management and virtual assistance

3. Examples of Reels/TikToks/short-form videos you have edited

4. Examples of social media accounts or brands you have supported, if available

5. The tools you use for video editing, design, scheduling, and project management

6. Your hourly rate or preferred monthly rate

7. Your weekly availability

8. Your timezone

9. An example of an SOP or workflow you have created, if available



**Important:** Please include the phrase **“Mindful Beginnings”** somewhere in your application so I know you read the full job description.



### Opportunity for Growth



I am looking for someone who can start part-time but potentially grow with Mindful Beginnings as the brand expands. For the right person, this could evolve into a larger Social Media Manager, Content Manager, or Brand Operations role.

title: Program Manager
description:
To be considered, you must fill out the application form below:





We are seeking a dynamic and talented General Program Manager to join our team. This role is perfect for a highly intelligent, motivated individual who is passionate about leveraging technology to make a difference in healthcare.



What is Ansible Health?

Ansible Health unites physicians, nurses, respiratory therapists, and tech experts from Columbia, Johns Hopkins, Google, Amazon, and other top institutions to revolutionize care for chronic disease patients. We combine elite clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology to deliver personalized, efficient care at scale. Our team's groundbreaking research, published in leading journals like Nature and PLOS, demonstrates our commitment to innovation. Backed by Bessemer, First Round Capital, AlleyCorp, Breyer Capital, and Inflect Capital, we're a Series A startup partnering with leading healthcare systems nationwide. Our mission is to genuinely improve patient outcomes, not just optimize metrics. If you're passionate about transforming healthcare through technology, join our diverse team in making a real impact.



The Job at a Glance

We're seeking a super smart, hungry, and resilient individual who is passionate about technology and healthcare to join us as a Program Manager. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and brings a strong organizational mindset to complex projects. You will be responsible for overseeing multiple complex programs across various departments to ensure successful delivery within scope, timeline, and budget. This role requires a self-motivated individual who can work independently and adapt to the dynamic nature of a growing startup in the healthcare technology space.



Responsibilities

- Impact the strategy and execution for AnsibleHealth's general operations, clinical operations, and technology initiatives, working closely with cross-functional teams.

- Work independently on projects through the full life cycle, overseeing clinical, operational, and technology aspects.

- Develop and manage program plans, schedules, budgets, and resource allocation to ensure successful delivery.

- Define program scope, objectives, and success criteria in collaboration with stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

- Establish program governance structures and processes, including risk management, issue management, and change management.

- Monitor and report on program progress, status, and performance to stakeholders and executive leadership.

- Ensure effective communication and alignment with stakeholders at all levels.

- Continuously identify and mitigate program risks and issues.

- Facilitate program-related meetings and workshops.

- Develop and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders to drive program success and identify growth opportunities.

- Bring a continuous improvement mindset to our operations to ensure we're ready to scale.

- Anticipate issues, propose solutions, manage dependencies, and identify areas for tool/process improvement.

- Collaborate with and steer internal teams, including Marketing, Engineering, Program Management, and Clinical Operations.



The ideal candidate should be comfortable to be in a constantly changing role with a high level of ambiguity - as we are a fast-moving startup operating in an ever-evolving environment. He or she should have excellent analytical, communication and management skills to succeed in this role.





Education

Bachelor's degree from one of the top five universities in the Philippines.





Required Qualifications and competencies

- Fresh graduates are welcome to apply; 0-5 years of relevant work experience is an advantage but not required.

- Demonstrated passion for technology and ability to quickly adapt to new digital tools and platforms.

- Exceptional organizational skills.

- Resilient mindset with the ability to bounce back from challenges and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

- Keen interest in healthcare and improving patient outcomes; prior healthcare experience is a plus but not mandatory.

- High intellectual curiosity and a hunger for personal and professional development.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think critically and creatively.

- Proficiency in Google Workspace and willingness to learn new software tools as needed.

- Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

- Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity in a startup environment.

- Eagerness to take on leadership roles and initiative to drive projects forward.

- Ability to influence and collaborate with stakeholders at all levels.

- Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work.

- Enthusiasm for continuous learning and process improvement.





The ideal candidate is a highly intelligent, motivated individual who is passionate about leveraging technology to make a difference in healthcare. We're looking for someone who can bring fresh perspectives, adapt quickly to new challenges, and contribute to our innovative and fast-paced work environment.



Job Details

Full-time: Full-time: 40 hours a week

Benefits: Flexible PTO and HMO coverage

Location: Remote (offshore, and willing to work US hours - EST/EDT)

- Resolve patient issues and complaints, identifying problems and finding appropriate solutions to ensure patient satisfaction while maintaining professional communication throughout the process.

- Achieve daily call quotas of 75-100 interactions.

- Adhere to established performance metrics to qualify for incentive plans tied to performance.





The ideal candidate for this role at Ansible Health is a dynamic professional who thrives in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment. They should also possess exceptional English communication skills, both written and verbal, coupled with meticulous attention to detail and strong organizational abilities. They should be adept at managing multiple priorities, from patient onboarding to referral management.





Required Qualifications and Competencies

- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as Nursing, Physical Therapy, or other healthcare-related fields.

- Minimum of 2 years of professional experience in customer service, preferably in a healthcare and/or sales environment.

- Sales experience or demonstrated ability to effectively communicate value propositions.

- Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills.

- Ability to explain complex medical concepts in easily understandable terms.

- Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

- Proficiency with CRM systems, EMR software, and standard office applications (e.g., Google Suite).

- Typing speed of at least 60 words per minute.

- Reliable internet connection (at least 30 Mbps) and a quiet home environment for work.

- Ability to work in US time zones (EST)



Nice to have

- Experience in the healthcare industry or with medical terminology.

- Proven track record in sales.

- Familiarity with remote patient monitoring systems.

- Knowledge of HIPAA regulations and healthcare privacy practices.





Job Details

Full-time: A minimum of 40 hours a week

Location: Remote (offshore, and willing to work Pacific/Eastern hours)

Benefits:

- Paid Time Off

- HMO Coverage on 3rd month

- With incentives



Best of luck!

description:

About the role

We're a fast-growing telehealth company, and we're looking for a QA / Test Engineer to own product quality end to end. You'll test features before they ship, own our release process, and keep our bug backlog under control so the team can move quickly without compromising quality.



This is a hands-on role that goes beyond manual testing. You'll own the path from "code complete" to "safely released" across our web and mobile products.



What you'll do

• Perform mobile device testing on Android, including reproducing and verifying device-specific issues.

• Triage, track, and manage bugs, driving them to closure and keeping the backlog under control.

• Partner with engineering and product to define test coverage and prioritize issues.

• Build and maintain automated tests to expand coverage and speed up regression testing.



What we're looking for

• Solid QA / software testing experience, ideally in a fast-moving product environment.

• Experience writing and improving test automation and test infrastructure, including using AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) to build and improve automation.

• Hands-on Android device testing experience.

• Comfortable testing web applications end to end.

• Experience working across dev, staging, and production environments and with release processes.

• Strong bug tracking, test case management, and triage skills.

• Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the judgment to distinguish release-blocking issues from minor ones.

• Able to drive quality independently while partnering closely with engineering and product.



Nice to have

• Healthcare or telehealth experience.

• Familiarity with mobile device management (MDM).

• Experience helping a team move toward a continuous release cycle.

title: Operations Virtual Assistant (VA)
description:
Operations Virtual Assistant (VA) — Custom Print, ERP & Operations



Role Overview



We are seeking an exceptionally organized, analytical, and tech-savvy Operations Virtual Assistant to manage the full lifecycle of custom-manufactured print products—from initial customer inquiry and quote creation to artwork coordination, production, delivery, and post-sales support. In addition to client-facing deal shepherding, you will collaborate directly with our Systems Architect to help design, test, and implement our Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform.



This role requires advanced proficiency in standard office tools (Excel, Word) and deep familiarity with modern workplace productivity software (Slack, Trello, CRM, and project management applications).



Key Responsibilities



End-to-End Client Management: Manage the entire client lifecycle from initial quote generation through order fulfillment, shipping updates, and post-sales follow-ups.



Artwork & Pre-Press Coordination: Serve as the central communication bridge between clients and the artwork department, managing proof approvals and verifying design specifications prior to print production.



Customer Care: Deliver friendly, calm, and professional communication across
, chat, and workplace apps to maintain high client satisfaction.



ERP Design, SOPs & Systems Work

ERP Implementation: Work alongside our Systems Architect to map operational workflows, test ERP modules, log system bugs, and assist in rolling out the database platform.



SOP Authoring & Documentation: Create, format, and continuously maintain clear, step-by-step Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) in Microsoft Word and internal documentation portals.



Data Management: Maintain strict CRM and ERP data hygiene, ensuring precise logs for pricing, inventory, order statuses, and client records.



Quoting, Sourcing & Logistics

Data-Driven Quoting & Math: Utilize custom Excel calculators to compute margin breakdowns, tiered pricing schedules, and custom specs with zero margins for error.



Vendor & Logistics Oversight: Liaise with suppliers and shipping partners to track material sourcing, monitor print timelines, and proactively address customs or freight delays.



Candidate Profile & Skill Requirements



Soft Skills



Absolute Attention to Detail: Micro-focused precision—catches misspellings in artwork proofs, minor discrepancies in spreadsheet calculations, or system errors before production starts.



Absolute Dedication to Urgency: High-bias for action; rapid turnarounds on quote requests, client messages, and internal task handoffs.



Cool and Calm: Unshakable under tight production deadlines, custom artwork revisions, or shipping disruptions.



Friendly and Amiable: Warm, approachable tone that builds trust with clients, internal developers, and print suppliers alike.



Analytical and Mathematical: Rapid, confident execution of arithmetic, margin calculations, unit conversions, and custom spec pricing models.



Organized to a Fault: Methodical approach to maintaining clear file structures, task boards, spreadsheet formatting, and daily workflow queues.

title: Podcast Producer / Manager
description:
We’re looking for an organized, proactive Podcast Producer / Manager to oversee the ongoing production and management of a podcast from recording through publication.



This role is ideal for someone who understands both the creative and operational sides of podcasting. You should be able to manage timelines, coordinate moving pieces, communicate clearly with hosts and guests, and make sure each episode moves through production smoothly and on schedule.



We’re looking for someone who can take ownership of the podcast workflow rather than waiting for step-by-step instructions.



You’ll help manage:



- The overall podcast production calendar

- Episode planning and scheduling

- Guest outreach, communication, and coordination

- Recording logistics

- Collecting guest bios, headshots, links, and promotional information

- Preparing hosts and guests with recording details and expectations

- Tracking episodes from recording through editing, approval, and publication

- Coordinating with podcast editors, video editors, designers, or other team members

- Reviewing edited episodes for quality and accuracy before publication

- Managing revisions and ensuring deadlines are met

- Uploading and scheduling episodes through the podcast hosting platform

- Writing or coordinating episode titles, descriptions, and show notes

- Adding links, resources, and guest information to episode pages

- Publishing episodes to YouTube when applicable

- Organizing podcast files, recordings, assets, and production documents

- Maintaining SOPs and production workflows

- Keeping the team informed about upcoming episodes, deadlines, and outstanding items



Depending on experience, this role may also support content strategy, episode development, repurposing, analytics, and growth initiatives.



What We're Looking For



You’re likely a good fit if you:



- Have experience managing or producing podcasts

- Are highly organized and comfortable managing multiple deadlines

- Can keep a production workflow moving without constant oversight

- Communicate professionally with guests and team members

- Understand the basic podcast production process from recording through publication

- Have strong attention to detail

- Can identify issues before they become delays

- Are comfortable following up with people and keeping projects on track

- Can work independently and take ownership of assigned responsibilities

- Are comfortable learning and managing new tools and systems

- Understand how podcast content connects to a larger content or marketing strategy



Experience with tools such as ClickUp, Asana, Trello, Notion, Airtable, Google Drive, Riverside, Zoom, Descript, Spotify for Creators, Buzzsprout, Libsyn, Captivate, Podbean, YouTube, or similar platforms is helpful.



Application Questions



Please include:



1. Tell us about your podcast production or management experience.  

How long have you been doing this work, and what types of podcasts have you supported?



2. What parts of the podcast production process have you personally managed?



3. Which project management, recording, editing, hosting, or publishing tools have you worked with?



4. How would you describe your experience level?



- Beginner: I understand podcast workflows and have assisted with some production tasks.

- Developing: I have managed parts of the podcast process but usually work from an established system with regular direction.

- Intermediate: I have managed ongoing podcast production and can independently coordinate schedules, guests, editors, assets, and publishing.

- Advanced: I have owned the full podcast production process, improved workflows, managed multiple contributors, and proactively solved production issues with minimal oversight.



5. Experience Check:  

Imagine a podcast publishes every Tuesday.



It is Friday afternoon. The guest has not returned their bio or headshot, the editor has not delivered the final episode, and the host has not approved the episode title.



Walk us through how you would handle the situation and keep the episode on track for Tuesday.



6. You are managing eight upcoming episodes at different stages of production. How would you organize and track everything to make sure nothing is missed?



7. If a guest has not responded to multiple scheduling
s, what would you do next?



8. What quality-control steps would you complete before publishing an episode?



9. What is your typical availability each week, and how many podcasts or episodes could you comfortably manage at one time?



Bonus Experience



Not required, but let us know if you also have experience with:



- Podcast strategy

- Guest research

- Guest outreach

- Interview preparation

- Episode research

- Writing show notes

- Writing episode titles

- YouTube publishing

- Video podcast workflows

- Social media repurposing

-
 marketing

- Podcast analytics

- Sponsorship coordination

- Content calendars

- SEO for podcasts or YouTube

- Creating SOPs

- Managing editors or other contractors

- Launching new podcasts

- Improving existing podcast workflows

title: Advertising & Media Project Manager
description:
Location: Philippines – Remote

Hours: 9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Pacific Time

Position: Full-Time, Internal Team Role



About the Role

Wicked Bionic is looking for an experienced Advertising & Media Project Manager to support our internal advertising and marketing team and keep projects, media, creative, content, information, and deadlines moving efficiently.

This is a non-client-facing position focused entirely on supporting our internal team.



This role requires someone who has built their career in advertising and understands media buying and advertising agency workflow. You need to understand how advertising campaigns move from strategy and planning through creative development, media planning and buying, trafficking, launch, optimization, and reporting.



You will not be responsible for developing media strategy or buying media yourself, but you must understand the process well enough to effectively support the people who do.



We are looking for someone who is exceptionally organized, proactive, and accountable. You know how to move work from one resource to the next, manage multiple deadlines, follow up before something becomes late, and make sure team members have what they need to complete their work.



The work can range from coordinating creative and media deliverables to pulling data for a report, updating tracking spreadsheets, organizing campaign information, maintaining Google Drive folders, tracking approvals, or making sure the next person in a workflow has everything they need.



If something is due Friday, no one should need to ask you on Friday whether it was completed.



What You’ll Do

- Support the internal advertising and marketing team across multiple campaigns and projects.

- Manage internal project timelines, assignments, deliverables, approvals, and deadlines.

- Coordinate workflow between strategy, creative, media planning and buying, trafficking, reporting, and other internal resources.

- Track media-related deadlines, assets, specifications, approvals, campaign information, and reporting needs.

- Make sure creative assets, information, and data get to the right team member at the right time.

- Proactively follow up on outstanding items before they affect a deadline.

- Maintain accurate project trackers, spreadsheets, status reports, calendars, and working documents.

- Pull, compile, and organize campaign data needed for reports and presentations.

- Gather information from multiple sources and turn it into organized, usable information for the team.

- Maintain highly organized Google Drive folders and file structures.

- Ensure documents, creative assets, reports, and working files are properly named, stored, updated, and easy to find.

- Track revisions, approvals, outstanding questions, responsibilities, and next steps.

- Prepare for internal meetings by identifying deadlines, missing information, and items requiring action.

- Document action items and follow through until they are completed.

- Identify inefficiencies and improve how the team organizes projects, information, files, and recurring processes.

- Step in wherever needed to support the team and get important work across the finish line.



Required Experience

- Professional advertising agency experience, including hands-on experience supporting media planning and buying workflows from campaign planning through execution and reporting, is required.

- Understanding of the relationship between media plans, creative assets, trafficking, campaign launch, optimization, and reporting.

- Demonstrated experience managing multiple advertising projects, deadlines, and deliverables simultaneously.

- Strong spreadsheet and project-tracking skills.

- Excellent organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail.

- Strong experience with Google Workspace, particularly Google Drive, Google Sheets, Google Docs, and Google Slides.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Experience working successfully as part of a remote team.

- Must be available to work a consistent 9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Pacific Time schedule.



The Person We’re Looking For

- You are the person who keeps things moving.

- You don't wait until a deadline to discover something is missing. You notice it early and go get it. You don't need to be reminded twice about an assignment. You follow through.

- You understand advertising and media well enough to anticipate what the creative team, media team, or reporting team will need next.

- You are an overachiever by nature. When you finish your own work, you look at what else needs attention. You notice the spreadsheet that hasn't been updated, the folder that needs organizing, the data that still needs to be pulled, or the deliverable that hasn't moved to the next person.

- You are organized, resourceful, responsive, and accountable. You enjoy supporting a busy team, are comfortable juggling many moving pieces, and take pride in making the people around you more effective.

- You enjoy being an important part of a team that works well together.



What Success Looks Like

The team operates better because you are there.



Projects move. Deadlines are met. Media and creative deliverables don't fall through the cracks. Tracking documents are current. Data is ready when reports are due. Files are where they belong. Information is easy to find. Team members know what they owe and when they owe it.



When you take responsibility for something, the team knows it will get done accurately and on time without having to ask twice.

title: Appointment Setter / Cold Caller (ISA) – US Home Services
description:
ABOUT US

The Buffalo Line is a small, founder-run company in Tulsa, Oklahoma. We give owner-run home-service businesses (plumbers, HVAC, septic, electricians, lawn care, pest control and more) their whole front door: a website, their Google listing, an AI receptionist that catches the calls they miss, and a steady flow of reviews.



THE JOB

Get business owners onto a 15-minute video call with our founder. You don't sell or close. You reach the owner, ask three quick questions, and book the call.



1. Warm leads (always first)

- Owners who asked about us through our
 and Instagram ads. Our AI assistant makes the first call; you're the person who follows up and books.

- New lead during your shift: call within 5 minutes. No answer: hang up before voi
 and call right back. Still nothing: leave one short voi
.

- Leads that came in overnight: first thing on your shift, newest first.

- Then follow our call schedule (up to 6 attempts over about two weeks).

- When they answer: confirm what work they do and where, about how many jobs they do a week, and that they make the decisions. Then offer two times on the founder's calendar.



2. Cold calls (when the warm list is empty)

- Call small home-service businesses from our lists (usually the owner picks up) and book the same 15-minute call.



3. Log every call

- Outcome and notes in our call desk, every time.



HOW WE WORK

- No pushy sales. Never promise anyone leads, jobs or income, and never quote a price that isn't in the script.

- "Not interested" is a fine answer. A booking that doesn't show up helps nobody, which is why the bonus pays on calls that actually happen.

- Anyone who asks not to be called again never gets called again.



SCHEDULE

- 16 to 20 hours a week, Monday to Friday, about 4 hours a day.

- US Central mornings, around 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM CT (9:00 PM to 1:00 AM Philippine time; 10:00 PM to 2:00 AM after the US clocks change on November 1). Final hours agreed together.



PAY

- $5/hour, paid every two weeks.

- Plus a $10 bonus for every booked call where the owner actually shows up.

- Long-term role, starting with an 8-week paid trial (full pay from day one, no unpaid test work).

- You'd be one of our first hires. As we grow, more hours and senior roles go to our early people first.



WE PROVIDE

- A US phone line (softphone app) and our web-based call desk

- Scripts, objection notes, training and regular coaching



YOU HAVE

- Clear, natural spoken English. You'll be talking with busy, plain-spoken American business owners.

- 1+ year of US cold calling or appointment setting (B2B, home services, marketing, or real estate ISA all count)

- Bonus: experience calling web or ad leads fast (speed-to-lead)

- You can work on your own most of the shift, with chat support and regular coaching

- A quiet room, a noise-cancelling headset, stable internet, and a backup for brownouts

- The habit of logging every call accurately



TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the word BUFFALO.

2. Send a link to a 1 to 2 minute voice recording (Vocaroo or Google Drive; check that the link opens) where you:

   - introduce yourself in 2 or 3 sentences,

   - read this opener as if it's a live call: "Hi, is this Mike? Mike, this is [your name] with The Buffalo Line. You asked about a website for Mike's Plumbing on
 the other day. I've got a couple quick questions, then I'll get you a time with our founder. Fair enough?"

   - then tell us, in your own words, what you'd say if Mike answers "I'm on a job right now."

3. Tell us your years of US calling experience and the industries, the dialers and CRMs you've used, your best week of booked appointments, your internet speed and backup plan, and the US Central hours you can work.



Applications without a voice recording won't be reviewed.

IMPORTANT: At the beginning of your application, write the words “VIRGINIA REAL ESTATE” so I know you read the entire job description.

Initial Paid Trial

title: QA Engineer / AI-Assisted Software Builder

Helpful experience includes test automation, Playwright, API testing, Linux, Docker, deployment, and cybersecurity. Please explain your current experience honestly; we value sound judgment and a willingness to learn.



Please apply through OnlineJobs with:

1. A short description of your software QA experience and one specific defect you found, including how you reproduced it and verified the fix.

2. One or two examples of software you built or improved with AI. Tell us which tools you used, what you personally did, and how you tested the result. You may share a demo, screenshots, or a sanitized walkthrough without revealing confidential client material.

description:

Polaris is a consulting agency with a bold mission: To help 1 million Founders to leverage time, reclaim freedom, and scale without sacrifice. ***Role Mission

Be the driving force behind the client acquisition process of established online coaches, consultants, and info product founders. These are expert-led businesses where the founder IS the brand. Your job is to oversee Meta ad campaigns such as lead ad campaigns, low-ticket course campaigns, and appointment/VSL campaigns — making sure that ad spend is turning into leads, customers, booked calls, and sales. - Budget management: Allocate and pace daily/lifetime budgets across campaigns, scale winners, cut losers early, and manage frequency, CPM, and delivery to protect efficiency as spend grows.

- Performance optimization: Monitor spend and cost per booked call daily; run structured A/B tests across creatives, audiences, and offers; flag anomalies (spend spikes, tracking discrepancies, fatigue) immediately; and act on the data with a proposed fix rather than reporting and moving on.



Creative Research & Production (Ad & Funnel Assets)

- Leverage AI to analyze competitor ads, industry trends, and the messaging angles of competitor landing pages and creatives.

- Set up Claude copywriting projects with accurate project instructions and context files from competitor analysis, copywriting guidelines, and company internal assets.

- Leverage AI to produce first-draft copywriting assets such as email campaigns, appointment reminders, campaign hooks & headlines, and landing page copy.

GoHighLevel CRM Setup & Management

- Set up GoHighLevel sub-accounts from scratch with domain, email, SMS (with A2P verification), custom fields, company details, and account snapshots accurately established.

- Build funnels such as lead magnet, webinars, VSL, and low-ticket digital product funnels — including setting up forms, integrations, and connecting automated email sequences.

- Email management with deliverability best practices, contact tagging, smartlist segmentation, and automated email sequence setup.

- Pipeline management with contact tagging, pipeline staging, and setting up triggers for automated opportunity creation / update.

- Manage the email list through deliverability best practices, contact tagging, and smartlist segmentation.

- Set up integrations across Meta and Google, as well as other platforms, using either GoHighLevel's internal features or Zapier.



Marketing & Ads Performance Tracking

- Set up tracking across Meta Pixels, Meta Conversion API, Google Analytics, and UTMs.

- Build dashboards and spreadsheets to accurately track and report key metrics across Meta ad campaigns and the GoHighLevel pipeline — content/opt-ins ? booked calls ? show rate.

- Comfortable identifying optimization opportunities based on weekly campaign data, and delivering reports that end with insight and recommendation — what to kill, scale, or test next — never just numbers.

.

Workflow Documentation

- Document recurring tasks and processes into clear SOPs and process maps, with the help of AI.

- Document funnel templates, automated workflows, forms, and other sub-account setups into shareable snapshots.



Role Requirements:

- Minimum 3 years virtual work experience in paid media and marketing operations — experience with coaches, consultants, course creators, or founder-led personal brands highly preferred (agency background highly preferred but not mandatory).

- Proven, hands-on experience managing Meta 
 & Instagram) ad campaigns end to end — strategy, audience targeting, creative production, budget management, and performance optimization — with results you can speak to.

- Strong grasp of tech stack integrations and tracking setups across Meta and Google Analytics (Pixel, Conversion API, UTM).

- Excellent written and spoken English — able to write ad and email copy in a founder's voice convincingly.

- Confident and proactive in using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity to improve productivity and output quality.

Role Results (KPIs)

title: Short-Form Video Editor - CapCut + AI B-Roll (Long Term)
description:
Read this first: we do not need someone who stacks clips and adds captions. Anyone can do that. We need someone who makes people stop scrolling.



The difference, in our words:

- An average editor cuts the clips together and adds subtitles.

- A strong editor builds a hook that lands in the first second, cuts on the beat, adds a sound effect where the eye needs to move, and knows exactly why the third second is where most people leave.



We are hiring the second one. If that is not you yet but you want it to be, say so - we train.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Edit 4 short video ads per day (30-60 seconds) in CapCut

- Build B-roll with AI tools (Higgsfield, Grok, and others we will teach you)

- Own the hook, the pacing, the sound design, the transitions

- Work from a written brief. We give you the script and the footage. The execution is yours.



WHAT WE MEASURE

Not how fast you export. How many people stop and watch. Every video we run gets real numbers back, and you will see them. If your edits get a higher click rate than the last ones, you get paid more. That is the whole deal.



WHAT WE NEED

- You hit deadlines. Every day. This is the floor, not the job.

- Stable internet and a real backup plan for power cuts. Not negotiable, we have been burned before.

- You watch ads for fun and you have opinions about them.

- Enough English to read a brief and ask a clear question.



WHAT YOU GET

- Full training from zero on our exact process.

- $400 to start, reviewed at 30 days and again at 90 days. Get good and you get paid more.

- Long term. We are not hiring for one project.



HOW TO APPLY - we delete applications that skip this

1. Start your message with the word MANGO.

2. Send a link to one short video you edited yourself. Not your best-looking one - the one where you made a creative decision you are proud of.

3. In two or three lines: tell us what that decision was and why you made it. A cut, a sound, a transition, a hook. Be specific.

4. One line each:

   - How many short-form videos have you edited in the last 30 days?

   - Your internet speed (paste a speedtest.net link)

   - What do you do when the power goes out mid-deadline?



Everyone who does all four steps gets a reply.

title: youtube strategist/ channel manager

### Job Posting: YouTube Strategist, Researcher & Channel Manager



**Job Title:**



`YouTube Strategist, Topic Researcher & Channel Manager (Part-Time to Full-Time)`



**Position Type:**



* **Starting Capacity:** Part-Time (5–20 hours/week) to align on systems and channel strategy.

* **Growth Path:** Ramps up to Full-Time (40 hours/week) as client volume and channel management duties scale over time.



**Compensation:** Competitive hourly rate paid direct bi-weekly via Wise or PayPal.



---



### About the Role



We are a fast-growing US media agency managing high-performing YouTube channels across educational, thought-leadership, and narrative video-essay niches.



We are looking for a sharp, data-driven **YouTube Strategist & Researcher** who understands YouTube culture, retention mechanics, and title/thumbnail packaging.



This role begins **Part-Time (5–20 hours/week)** focused on deep-dive topic research, competitive analysis, and video packaging. If you bring strong **Channel Management & Operations** capabilities (managing offshore video editors, YouTube Studio backend publishing, and QA review cycles), **this role will scale directly into a 40 hour/week Full-Time position** as our client pipeline expands.



---



### Primary Responsibilities



#### **Pillar 1: Strategy, Research & Packaging (Core Starting Role)**



* **Topic & Competitor Research:** Mine YouTube, Reddit, forums, and Google Trends to identify high-demand video concepts, viral angles, and content gaps.

* **Packaging Optimization:** Craft high-CTR **Title + Thumbnail Concept combinations** for every long-form upload before scripts are drafted.

* **Hook & Narrative Frameworks:** Draft structural outlines focusing on 30-second retention hooks, story pacing, and audience pay-off moments.

* **Performance Analysis:** Review YouTube Studio metrics (CTR, Average View Duration, retention dips/spikes) to provide actionable tweaks for future videos.



#### **Pillar 2: Channel Management & Operations (Scaling to Full-Time)**



* **Production Management:** Direct and coordinate our team of offshore video editors and thumbnail designers to enforce deadlines and high quality.

* **YouTube Studio Publishing:** Manage complete backend publishing—uploading final renders, formatting descriptions, SEO tags, end screens, playlists, and pinned comments.

* **Asset & Workflow Management:** Keep video assets, script drafts, and client review feedback organized in Google Drive / 
 / Notion.

* **Quality Assurance (QA):** Perform full QA reviews on video edits before client delivery to ensure pacing, graphics, audio, and branding meet agency standards.



---



### Requirements



* **Proven YouTube Track Record:** Demonstrated experience researching, packaging, or managing YouTube channels with proven growth or views.

* **YouTube Analytics Mastery:** Deep understanding of YouTube Studio metrics (CTR, AVD, Impression Click-Through, Audience Retention graphs).

* **Native-Level Written English:** Flawless written communication for titling, hook writing, and team/client coordination.

* **Software Familiarity:** Experience with YouTube Studio, Google Drive, 
, and project tools like Notion or ClickUp.



---



### How to Apply (READ CAREFULLY)

title: Senior SEO Manager: $8 to $10 per hour
description:
About Us: We are a U.S.-based web design, digital marketing, and SEO agency with over 16+ years of experience helping businesses grow through organic search and lead generation.



We are seeking a highly experienced Senior SEO Manager with a proven track record of ranking home service businesses in competitive U.S. local markets.

To be considered for an interview, you must provide SEO reports or case studies from at least three successful local or national 



SEO campaigns completed within the last 12 months.



Applications without verifiable recent SEO results will not be considered.



About the Role:



This is not a strategy-only position.



We are looking for a hands-on SEO leader who can actively manage, execute, optimize, and improve SEO campaigns across multiple client accounts while overseeing SEO team members.



You must be comfortable working directly inside websites, identifying technical and content issues, implementing solutions, and driving measurable improvements in rankings, traffic, and lead generation.



If you have successfully ranked businesses in industries such as HVAC, roofing, plumbing, electrical, landscaping, pest control, or similar service categories, and understand how Google Business Profiles, local landing pages, and service-area SEO generate leads, this role is for you.



Key Responsibilities

1. SEO Strategy, Execution & Team Management

Manage SEO campaigns across multiple client accounts

Oversee and mentor SEO specialists and content teams

Prioritize tasks based on impact and business goals

Ensure consistent execution of SEO processes and SOPs

Drive measurable improvements in rankings (AI Overview, ChatGPT, Perplexity), organic traffic, and lead generation



2. On-Page SEO & Content Optimization

Optimize service pages, city/location pages, and blog content for local search intent and conversions

Review and improve SEO content including service pages, FAQs, and blog articles

Implement proper heading structures (H1-H4), internal linking strategies, schema markup, and conversion-focused calls-to-action

Align content with search intent and user needs—not just keyword placement

Identify content gaps and expansion opportunities



3. Technical SEO



Perform comprehensive technical SEO audits and implement recommendations, including:

Core Web Vitals optimization

Crawlability and indexation improvements

Site architecture and internal linking enhancements

Redirect management, canonicalization, and noindex implementation

Structured data and schema markup implementation

WordPress SEO optimization across various themes and page builders



You should be comfortable working directly with developers and clearly communicating technical requirements, priorities, and expected outcomes.



4. Local SEO (High Priority)

Fully optimize Google Business Profiles, including categories, services, products, media, posts, and FAQs

Build and optimize city, neighborhood, and service-area landing pages

Maintain citation consistency and NAP accuracy across directories

Develop strategies to improve local visibility and map pack rankings

Demonstrate a strong understanding of proximity, relevance, prominence, and local ranking signals



5. SOP Execution & Continuous Improvement

Follow established SEO SOPs with consistency and accountability

Identify process gaps and opportunities for improvement

Contribute to developing scalable SEO systems and documentation

Maintain organized task management and reporting processes



6. Analytics, Reporting & Performance Tracking

Monitor rankings, traffic, conversions, and lead generation metrics

Conduct SEO audits and competitive analysis

Translate SEO data into actionable recommendations for clients and internal teams

Deliver clear performance reporting and strategic insights



Experience with Search Atlas is a strong advantage.



Required Qualifications

Must-Have

7+ years of hands-on SEO experience

Proven success ranking U.S.-based home service businesses

Demonstrated local SEO expertise with Google Business Profiles and local search campaigns

Strong technical SEO knowledge and implementation experience

Advanced on-page SEO and content optimization skills

Extensive experience with WordPress websites



Strong knowledge of:

Ahrefs

SEMrush

BrightLocal

Screaming Frog

Google Search Console

Google Analytics



Experience implementing schema markup for local and service businesses

Ability to provide recent SEO reports or case studies demonstrating measurable results

Process-driven mindset with strong documentation and communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

Agency experience managing multiple client accounts

Experience managing SEO teams

Familiarity with CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization)

Experience with Search Atlas

What Success Looks Like



Within the first 6–12 months, you will:

Improve rankings for high-value service and city keywords

Increase qualified leads from organic search and Google Business Profiles

Deliver scalable SEO implementations across multiple websites

Improve execution efficiency through stronger SOPs and processes

Help clients achieve measurable business growth through SEO



How to Apply



Please submit:

Your resume

A brief summary of your home services SEO experience

SEO reports or case studies from at least three successful campaigns completed within the last 12 months

Examples of rankings, traffic growth, lead generation improvements, or other measurable SEO outcomes



Applications without recent proof of results will not be considered.

title: Product Manager (Technical) / Software Architect
description:

This role combines system-level thinking, architectural oversight, and clear, actionable documentation—producing deliverables engineers can build from directly. • Strong understanding of software architecture principles, REST APIs, and modular system design.

• Ability to evaluate trade-offs between architectural purity, delivery speed, and scalability.

• Prior experience functioning as a bridge between engineering and design, ensuring clarity and readiness for execution.

title: Government Contract research
description:
Rella Electric

Government Procurement & GC Outreach Coordinator —

SOP

1. Your Mission

Your job is to find qualified government construction opportunities and turn them into

bidding opportunities for Rella Electric.

You are not an electrical estimator. You are responsible for the business-development process

surrounding estimating:

Find → Research → Qualify → Identify GCs → Make Contact → Get Bid Opportunity →

Follow Up → Schedule Owner Meeting → Track Results

There are two primary ways Rella can obtain work:

Prime Contractor: Rella bids directly to a government agency for electrical work.

Electrical Subcontractor: A General Contractor (GC) is bidding or has won a government

project and hires Rella to perform electrical work.

Both are important, but finding GC subcontracting opportunities is a major focus of this

position.

2. About Rella Electric

When speaking with contractors, you represent Rella Electric.

Rella Electric is an electrical contractor serving the New York market with experience performing

public and commercial electrical construction.

Important qualifications include:

● NYS Certified MBE

● NYC Certified MBE

● Port Authority DBE

● NYS SBE

● Licensed electrical contractor

● Public-works experience

● NYC school project experience

● Prevailing-wage experience

● Solar

● Lighting and lighting controls

● Electrical distribution

● Fire alarm / low-voltage capabilities

● Government construction experience

Your objective is not simply to sell the certification.

The message is:

Rella is a qualified electrical contractor capable of performing the work, and our

MBE/DBE certifications can also help contractors meet participation requirements.

3. Your Title

Use:

Procurement & Government Opportunities Coordinator

Rella Electric

You may tell contractors:

“I handle government opportunity research and procurement outreach for Rella Electric.”

Do not represent yourself as an estimator, project manager, owner, attorney, engineer or

authorized contract signer.

4. Who Handles What

You — Procurement Coordinator

You handle:

Research

Opportunity tracking

Government websites

Bidder lists

GC research

Contact research

Vendor registrations

Initial outreach

Follow-ups

Scheduling

Document organization

Deadline tracking

Nick — Estimator

Nick handles:

Electrical takeoffs

Pricing

Labor calculations

Material pricing

Scope review

Estimate preparation

Technical bid questions

Christian — Owner

Christian handles:

GO / NO-GO decisions

Important GC relationships

Pricing approval when required

Negotiations

Contracts

Major technical/business decisions

Final commitments

Never agree to pricing, contract terms, bonding commitments, schedules, manpower

commitments or scope changes without approval.

5. The Four Types of Opportunities

Every project must be classified.

A — PRIME

Rella could potentially bid directly to the government agency.

B — ACTIVE GC BID

A larger project is currently bidding.

Your objective:

Find every GC bidding → get Rella’s electrical estimate to as many legitimate bidders as

possible.

C — AWARDED GC

The government has already awarded the project.

Your objective:

Find winning GC → determine whether electrical has been awarded → introduce Rella →

pursue electrical package.

D — FUTURE

Project is planned/upcoming but isn’t ready to bid.

Track it so Rella gets involved early.

6. Websites To Search

NYC — HIGH PRIORITY

NYC PASSPort / Procurement Navigator



Look for NYC agency opportunities, construction contracts and M/WBE opportunities.

NYC City Record Online



Search BOTH:

New solicitations

Contract awards

Awards are extremely important.

NYC School Construction Authority



Look for:

Electrical upgrades

School renovations

Lighting

Fire alarm

Emergency power

Solar

HVAC-related electrical

Capital improvements

Look for bidder/plan-holder information.

NYC Department of Design & Construction



Look for:

Current solicitations

Construction projects

Plan holders

RFP holders

Awards

NYC DCAS



NYC DEP



NYCHA



Checkbook NYC



Use primarily for contract and contractor intelligence.

Research which GCs are consistently receiving NYC contracts.

7. New York State

NYS Contract Reporter



HIGH PRIORITY.

NYS Office of General Services



DASNY



NYPA



Look especially for:

Electrical infrastructure

Lighting

Energy efficiency

Solar

EV charging

Power distribution

Building upgrades

8. Transportation / Infrastructure

MTA



Look for electrical work associated with:

Stations

Facilities

Power

Lighting

Communications

Infrastructure

Capital construction

Port Authority of NY & NJ



HIGH PRIORITY because Rella has DBE certification.

Look at:

Airports

PATH

Bridges

Tunnels

Terminals

Facilities

Infrastructure

NYSDOT



Look for both direct opportunities and large primes needing DBE participation.

NYS Thruway Authority



9. Local Government

Monitor:

Westchester County Procurement



Also monitor appropriate procurement sources for:

Yonkers

Putnam County

Westchester municipalities

School districts within Rella’s service territory

If you discover another legitimate government procurement website, add it to the Source List

and notify Christian.

10. Federal





Federal opportunities are a separate category.

Look particularly at:

GSA

Veterans Affairs

USACE

Federal facilities

Department of Defense

Federal transportation/infrastructure

Do not assume an NYC contract will appear on 
.

11. Search Terms

Never search only “electrical.”

Rotate searches using:

Electrical contractor

Electrical construction

Electrical upgrade

Division 26

Division 27

Division 28

Lighting

Lighting controls

Fire alarm

Low voltage

Security

Generator

Emergency power

Switchgear

Service upgrade

Solar

Photovoltaic / PV

Energy efficiency

LL88

EV charging

Building renovation

School renovation

Capital improvement

HVAC

Mechanical upgrade

Boiler replacement

Infrastructure

Resiliency

Important

A project does NOT have to say “Electrical Contract.”

A:

$20 million school renovation

may contain:

$1–3 million of electrical work.

Therefore, larger construction projects must also be reviewed for electrical subcontracting

opportunities.

12. Geographic Focus

Priority:

NYC

Westchester

Putnam

Other locations should be flagged for Christian before significant time is spent pursuing them.

13. Morning Search Routine

Every morning:

Step 1

Check for new solicitations.

Step 2

Check for upcoming bid deadlines.

Step 3

Check for addenda affecting existing opportunities.

Step 4

Check recently announced awards.

Step 5

Look for bidder/plan-holder lists.

Step 6

Update the Master Opportunity Tracker.

Step 7

Identify anything requiring immediate attention.

A mandatory walkthrough tomorrow is urgent.

A bid due in three weeks is not urgent unless documents/actions are required now.

14. Information Required For Every

Opportunity

Capture as much of the following as available:

Date Found

Source

Agency

Project Name

Project Number

Location

Project Description

Electrical Scope

Prime/Subcontract Opportunity

Estimated Contract Value

Electrical Package Value if known

MBE Goal

WBE Goal

DBE Goal

SDVOB Goal if applicable

Bid Date

Bid Time

Pre-Bid Meeting

Site Walk

Mandatory?

Bond Required?

Bid Bond %

Performance Bond?

Payment Bond?

Plans Link

Specifications Link

Addenda

Bidder List

Plan-Holder List

GCs Identified

Status

Next Action

Do not guess missing information.

Write:

UNKNOWN — NEEDS REVIEW

15. First-Level Qualification

Before sending something to Christian, answer:

Is there electrical work?

Is it geographically relevant?

Is Rella potentially qualified?

Is there an MBE/DBE opportunity?

When is it due?

Is there a mandatory walkthrough?

Can we identify the GC bidders?

Has it already been awarded?

Is there enough information to take a next action?

Don’t send Christian 50 irrelevant solicitations.

Your value is filtering the noise.

16. GO / NO-GO Process

When you identify a qualified opportunity, send Christian a concise summary:

PROJECT:

AGENCY:

LOCATION:

VALUE:

BID DATE:

ELECTRICAL SCOPE:

MBE/DBE GOAL:

BOND:

MANDATORY WALK:

PRIME OR SUB:

GC BIDDERS:

WHY I THINK IT’S RELEVANT:

Then:

DECISION NEEDED: GO / NO-GO / NEED MORE INFORMATION

Christian makes the decision.

17. When Christian Says GO

If PRIME:

Collect all documents → organize files → confirm deadlines → identify forms → send package

to Nick/Christian → monitor addenda.

If GC SUBCONTRACT:

Find every legitimate GC bidding the project.

Don’t stop after finding one.

18. GC Research SOP

For every GC, find:

Legal/company name

Website

Main telephone

Estimating

Estimator name

Estimator phone

Preconstruction contact

Procurement contact

M/WBE or DBE coordinator

Vendor registration page

Subcontractor prequalification page

Office location

Projects they commonly perform

Government agencies they work with

Record everything.

19. Active Bid Outreach

If a GC is currently bidding a project:

Hello, my name is [NAME], and I’m the Procurement & Government Opportunities Coordinator

with Rella Electric.

We’re a certified MBE/DBE electrical contractor and noticed your company is bidding

[PROJECT NAME / NUMBER].

We’re interested in pricing the electrical scope and would like to be added to your subcontractor

bidder list.

Could you please connect me with the estimator handling this project or let me know where we

should send our information?

If connected with estimator:

We’d like to price Division 26 and any applicable electrical scope. Could you please send us

your bid invitation and current documents/addenda?

20. Awarded Contract Outreach

This is a major part of the position.

When you discover a GC has received an award:

Hi, this is [NAME] with Rella Electric. I’m calling from our Procurement & Government

Opportunities team.

First, congratulations on the award of [PROJECT].

Rella Electric is a certified MBE/DBE electrical contractor, and we’re reaching out to see

whether the electrical package has been awarded yet or whether there may be an opportunity

for us to participate.

Who would be the best person for me to speak with regarding electrical subcontracting?

If electrical is already awarded:

Thank you. We’d still love to get Rella registered with your company and added to your electrical

bidder list for upcoming projects. Who would be the best person to coordinate that with?

Never treat a “no” as useless information.

The objective is also to build the GC relationship for the next project.

21. General GC Introduction

Don’t wait for a specific project every time.

Target GCs repeatedly winning government contracts.

Hi, my name is [NAME] with Rella Electric. I handle government procurement and contractor

outreach.

We’re a certified MBE/DBE electrical contractor performing public work in New York.

I’m reaching out because your company performs a significant amount of public construction,

and we’d like to become an electrical subcontractor resource for your estimating team.

What’s the best way to get Rella added to your subcontractor database and Division 26 bid list?

22. When Someone Wants To Speak With

Christian

Excellent. This is one of your objectives.

Say:

Absolutely. Christian Farella is the owner of Rella Electric. I’d be happy to coordinate a call with

him. What day and time works best for you?

Collect:

Name

Company

Phone


Project

What they want to discuss

Suggested meeting times

Then schedule according to Christian’s availability.

Before the meeting, send Christian a short briefing.

23. Owner Meeting Brief

Before every meeting:

COMPANY: ABC Construction

PERSON: John Smith — Senior Estimator

PROJECT: PS-XXX Electrical Renovation

PROJECT VALUE: $12.5M

AGENCY: SCA

MBE GOAL: X%

WHY THEY’RE CALLING: Looking for electrical pricing

WHAT WE HAVE ALREADY SENT: Capability statement

NEXT DEADLINE: October XX

IMPORTANT NOTES: [Anything Christian should know]

Christian should never enter the call wondering:

“Who is this person?”

24. Follow-Up System

One
 isn’t business development.

Initial Contact

 + call when appropriate.

Follow-Up #1

Approximately 2 business days later.

Follow-Up #2

Approximately 5 business days later.

Follow-Up #3

Approximately 7–10 business days later, depending on the bid deadline.

For active bids, adjust follow-ups around the actual deadline.

Do not harass contractors.

Every interaction gets logged.

25. Capability Statement

When appropriate, send Rella’s current approved capability statement.

Do not modify certifications, licenses, experience, project history, employee counts or other

company qualifications yourself.

If someone requests information that isn’t in the approved company materials:

Ask Christian.

26. Vendor Registration

Whenever a legitimate GC has:

Vendor registration

Subcontractor registration

Prequalification

Bidder database

Get Rella registered when the information requested is administrative and already approved.

If they request:

Financial statements

Bank information

SSN

Personal financial information

Insurance commitments

Bonding commitments

Legal certifications

Contract signatures

W-9 changes

Sensitive company information

STOP and send to Christian.

27. Estimating Handoff

Once an opportunity is approved:

Send Nick a clean package containing:

Project name

Agency

GC(s)

Electrical scope

Plans

Specifications

Addenda

Bid date

Internal estimate deadline

Walkthrough information

GC bid instructions

Don’t send:

“Here’s a link. Can you look at it?”

Organize the opportunity first.

28. Multiple-GC Rule

This is extremely important.

If:

Turner

Skanska

XYZ Construction

ABC Builders

are all bidding the same project, and all are legitimate potential primes:

Rella should attempt to get its electrical proposal in front of all applicable bidders, subject to

any procurement restrictions and Christian/Nick’s approval.

Do not assume one GC = one project.

29. Addenda

For every active estimate:

Check regularly for new addenda.

Record:

Addendum #

Date

What changed

Sent to Nick?

Immediately notify Nick if an addendum could affect pricing or scope.

30. Bid Results

After bid day:

Don’t abandon the opportunity.

Find:

Bid results

Apparent low bidder

Award status

Final awarded GC

Award value

Update tracker.

Then transition the project:

ACTIVE BID → AWARD PURSUIT

Contact the winning GC.

31. Build the GC Database

Over time, build a separate database of contractors.

Track:

GC

Agencies Worked For

Estimator Contacts

Procurement Contacts

MBE/DBE Contact

Division 26 Contact

Vendor Registered?

Prequalified?

Projects Quoted

Last Contact

Next Follow-Up

Relationship Status

The long-term objective is that eventually GCs send opportunities to Rella without us having

to find them first.

32. Priority Levels

🔴 URGENT

Mandatory walkthrough approaching

Bid due within several days

GC requesting price

Missing addendum

Meeting request

Document required immediately

🟠 HIGH

Strong qualified opportunity

New GC award

GC requesting prequalification

Important estimator response

🟡 NORMAL

Research

New opportunity

Routine follow-up

Vendor registration

⚪ LOW

Future opportunity

Weak lead

Long-term research

33. Daily Report

At the end of each working day, send a concise report.

🔥 ACTION REQUIRED FROM CHRISTIAN

Anything requiring:

GO/NO-GO

Meeting

Decision

Signature

Contract

Bonding

Financial information

🟢 NEW PRIME OPPORTUNITIES

Project + agency + value + due date.

🔵 GC BID OPPORTUNITIES

Project + bidding GCs + electrical opportunity.

🟣 NEW AWARDS

Project + winning GC + award value + electrical status.

🟡 OUTREACH

Companies contacted and responses.

📅 MEETINGS

Anything scheduled.

⚠️ DEADLINES

Next 7 days.

34. Weekly Report

Every Friday provide:

Opportunities screened: ___

Qualified opportunities: ___

Prime opportunities: ___

GC subcontract opportunities: ___

New awards researched: ___

New GCs identified: ___

GCs contacted: ___

Decision-maker contacts identified: ___

Vendor/prequalification applications: ___

New bidder lists Rella joined: ___

Bid invitations received: ___

Opportunities sent to Nick: ___

Quotes submitted: ___

Meetings scheduled: ___

Follow-ups outstanding: ___

Potential opportunity value: $___

Then:

Top 5 Opportunities

The five opportunities needing the most attention next week.

35. Initial Performance Targets

For the first month, focus more on quality and learning than raw numbers.

Once trained, reasonable weekly activity targets are:

50+ opportunities screened

10+ qualified opportunities identified

10+ new relevant GC contacts

5+ vendor/prequalification/bid-list additions attempted

100% of approved opportunities followed up

100% of known addenda tracked

100% of important deadlines entered

100% of owner meeting requests escalated

These numbers can be adjusted once we understand actual volume.

36. What NOT To Do

Never:

Submit a bid without authorization.

Provide pricing yourself.

Sign anything.

Agree to a contract.

Promise manpower.

Promise completion dates.

Promise bonding capacity.

Promise insurance limits.

Change Rella’s qualifications.

Claim experience Rella doesn’t have.

Guess answers to technical questions.

Represent yourself as the owner.

Give sensitive financial information.

Tell a GC something is included/excluded in Rella’s scope without Nick/Christian confirming.

If unsure:

“Let me confirm that with our owner/estimator and get back to you.”

37. First 30 Days

Week 1 — Training

Learn Rella.

Learn certifications.

Learn websites.

Learn terminology.

Find opportunities but obtain approval before broad outreach.

Christian reviews what you’re finding.

Week 2 — Research + Outreach

Begin contacting approved GCs.

Start vendor registrations.

Build GC database.

Start tracking awards.

Week 3 — Pipeline Development

Increase outreach.

Follow up with previous contacts.

Research repeat government GCs.

Get Rella added to bid lists.

Week 4 — Review

Report:

What sources produced opportunities?

Which GCs responded?

How many bid invitations?

How many estimates?

How many meetings?

Where are we wasting time?

Where are we seeing traction?

Then improve the process.

38. The Most Important Rule

Your success is NOT measured by how many government projects you find.

Your success is measured by whether your research and outreach create real opportunities

for Rella Electric to bid and win electrical work.

The ultimate process is:

Government project identified

↓

Electrical opportunity identified

↓

GC bidders identified

↓

Rella introduced

↓

Bid invitation obtained

↓

Nick estimates

↓

Rella submits

↓

You follow up

↓

GC wins

↓

Rella pursues subcontract

↓

Christian handles negotiation

↓

Contract / Backlog

That’s the entire job.

title: Meta Ads Specialist (Facebook and Instagram): Strategy, Creative, and Reporting
description:
Meta Ads Specialist for a professional association in couples recovery



We are a professional association that supports couples rebuild after infidelity and chronic deception. Our work is serious and personal. We'll share our organization's name with candidates we invite to interview. We're looking for one person or a small team to run our
 and Instagram advertising from start to finish, and to tell us honestly what is working.



What you'll do



Learn our audience. You'll start by interviewing us in depth about who we serve, what they're feeling, and what makes them take the next step.

Build the full funnel, not only cold ads. You'll plan and launch top of funnel campaigns that introduce us to new people, middle of funnel campaigns that build trust, and bottom of funnel retargeting campaigns that invite people to act. This includes building and maintaining custom audiences (website visitors, video viewers,
 and Instagram 
, and our customer and
 lists from GoHighLevel), lookalike audiences, and exclusions so we don't keep paying to reach people who already bought. Retargeting is a required part of this role.

Create the ads. You'll make the static images and short videos for
 and Instagram, yourself or with your own team.

Report on results and money. You'll send a clear weekly report showing what's working, what isn't, and what each result costs us: cost per lead, cost per booked call, and return on ad spend. You'll also set up or check tracking (Meta Pixel and Conversions API) so we can follow a person from their first ad to a purchase in our CRM, GoHighLevel.

Work alongside our organic social media. We have an in-house team member who handles our organic (unpaid)
 and Instagram posts. You won't be responsible for organic posting, but you'll coordinate with them so ads and posts carry a consistent message, turn strong organic posts into ads, use people who engage with our posts in retargeting, and monitor comments on our ads, working with our team on responses.



You're a strong fit if you have:



At least 2 years of hands-on experience running Meta ads for clients

Experience in coaching, therapy, mental health, wellness, relationships, online courses, or professional training

Proven experience building custom audiences, lookalikes, and retargeting campaigns, with results you can show us

A working knowledge of Meta's ad policies on sensitive and personal topics, and a record of getting rejected ads approved

A portfolio of ads you made yourself

Clear written and spoken English

Some availability during US Eastern business hours for meetings



Nice to have:



Experience with GoHighLevel

Video creation skills beyond basic editing, such as scripting, captions, and motion graphics



What we offer



We offer steady, meaningful work with an organization that helps couples heal. We'll give you a clear brief, quick feedback, and direct access to the people who know our audience best. Strong candidates will be invited to a 30 minute interview and then a small paid trial project of 2 to 4 weeks. If the trial goes well, we'll move to an ongoing monthly agreement.



How to apply



Please apply only through our application form. We don't review applications sent by message or
.



Application form: 



The form takes about 25 to 35 minutes and includes a short screen recording (3 to 5 minutes) where you review a few real ads from the free Meta Ad Library. That recording matters more to us than anything else in your application.



To show us you've read this posting, type the word Recovery in the "Job post check" question on the form.



We read every application and look forward to seeing your work.

title: 3d Mesh Modeler/ STL Designer for CNC sign manufacturing
description:
3D Mesh Modeler / STL Designer for CNC-Carved Signs



Remote | Philippines | $4 USD per hour | Project-Based to Full-Time





We are a U.S. business creating custom signs, business signage, and personalized products. We are expanding production of HDU (high-density urethane) signage and other 3D-carved signs and are looking for a skilled, dependable 3D modeler to grow with our company.



About the Role



You will convert vector artwork and 3D scans into clean, detailed 3D mesh models and STL files suitable for CNC carving. Projects may include business logos, lettering, decorative reliefs, dimensional signs, and custom designs.



This position starts with individual projects, with hours limited to available work. As production grows, we expect the role to increase to 10–20 hours per week, then potentially 40 hours per week, with additional overtime opportunities as needed. Increased hours will depend on workload, performance, and company growth.



Responsibilities



* Convert vector files, including SVG, AI, EPS, DXF, and vector PDFs, into dimensional models and relief designs.

* Clean up and refine 3D scans, repairing holes, artifacts, and mesh issues.

* Create accurate STL files with the correct dimensions, scale, depth, and detail for CNC carving.

* Design with practical carving requirements in mind, including material thickness, tool access, and achievable detail.

* Provide preview images for review and make requested revisions.

* Deliver final STL files and editable source files with organized filenames.

* Communicate progress, questions, estimated hours, and deadlines clearly.

* Keep customer artwork, company files, and project information confidential.



Required Qualifications



* Demonstrated experience in 3D mesh modeling and STL creation.

* Experience converting vector artwork or 3D scans into usable 3D models.

* A portfolio showing relevant work, preferably relief carvings, dimensional logos, signage, or CNC-ready models.

* Proficiency in suitable modeling software, such as Blender, ZBrush, Rhino, Aspire, ArtCAM, or comparable tools.

* Understanding of mesh quality, file scaling, and preparing models for CNC carving.

* Fluent English communication, both written and spoken.

* Strong attention to detail, reliable follow-through, and willingness to accept feedback.

* Reliable internet access and a computer capable of handling the required software and files.



Experience with HDU signage and CNC relief carving is strongly preferred.



Pay and Working Terms



* Rate: $4 USD per hour.

* Payment: Biweekly through Wise.

* Initial schedule: Project-based, with no guaranteed minimum weekly hours.

* Growth opportunity: Potential progression to 10–20 hours per week and eventually 40 hours per week as production increases.

* A signed contractor agreement and nondisclosure agreement (NDA) are required before work begins.

* You must be able to receive payments through Wise.

* Work hours and project progress must be recorded accurately.



We are looking for someone interested in building a long-term working relationship and growing with our team and company. 



How to Apply



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with:



1. Your current résumé.

2. A portfolio with samples of your 3D modeling, STL, relief-carving, or scan-conversion work. Explain your contribution to each sample.

3. A brief Loom video introducing yourself, explaining why you are a good fit, and showing one relevant project.

4. The software you use and your experience preparing files for CNC carving.

5. Your availability and confirmation that you accept the $4 USD hourly rate, biweekly Wise payments, contractor agreement, and NDA requirements.



Application subject: HSA – 3D Mesh / STL Modeler

title: Home Care Inquiry Specialist
description:
Home Care Inquiry Specialist

Help Families Navigate One of the Most Important Decisions They May Face

Our agency is looking for a Home Care Inquiry Specialist to support families who are exploring care for an aging loved one and help guide them from their first inquiry to a Care Consultation with our team.

Families often contact us during a stressful or uncertain time. They may be worried about a parent living alone, overwhelmed by caregiving responsibilities, or unsure what type of support is available.

You will often be the first person they speak with.

We are looking for someone who can listen carefully, ask thoughtful questions, provide reassurance, explain our services clearly, and help families determine the right next step.

This is also a highly organized, results-oriented role. Success requires disciplined follow-up, accurate lead tracking, strong documentation, and a commitment to making sure no prospective client falls through the cracks.

What You’ll Do

As our Home Care Inquiry Specialist, you will manage inquiries from prospective clients, family members, referral sources, and others seeking information about home care services.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Speaking with families about the challenges they are experiencing with an aging loved one

• Listening carefully and asking questions to understand the family’s needs, concerns, urgency, and decision-making process

• Explaining how home care works and how our services may be able to help

• Building trust and rapport with families who may be stressed, emotional, uncertain, or unfamiliar with senior care

• Identifying the appropriate next step for each inquiry

• Converting qualified inquiries into Care Consultations

• Following a defined and disciplined lead follow-up protocol

• Proactively following up with families who are interested in care but are not yet ready to move forward

• Maintaining consistent contact until there is a clear outcome

• Accurately entering and updating lead information in Salesforce

• Maintaining detailed notes regarding family circumstances, care needs, decision-makers, concerns, timing, and next steps

• Tracking every inquiry through the lead pipeline and ensuring that no opportunity is lost because of incomplete follow-up

• Prioritizing inquiries based on urgency, family needs, and readiness to move forward

• Working within WellSky to review client information and support the intake process

• Coordinating with internal team members to ensure a smooth transition from inquiry to Care Consultation and start of care

• Taking ownership of each lead and being accountable for the next step

• Tracking activity and outcomes, including inquiries, follow-ups, Care Consultations scheduled, and lead conversion

What We’re Looking For

• Excellent English-speaking and communication skills are required

• Previous Salesforce or other CRM experience is required

• Previous WellSky experience is preferred

• Previous experience in sales, home care, senior care, healthcare, admissions, intake, customer service, or another consultative service environment is strongly preferred

• You are an excellent listener and can make people feel comfortable discussing personal and emotional situations

• You communicate with warmth, confidence, and professionalism

• You are comfortable speaking with adult children, spouses, seniors, and other family decision-makers

• You can explain services clearly without sounding scripted or overly sales-oriented

• You understand how to guide a conversation toward a decision or next step

• You are comfortable asking questions, addressing concerns, and following up consistently

• You understand that many families will not make a decision after one conversation

• You are highly organized and able to manage multiple leads at different stages of the decision-making process

• You are disciplined about completing follow-up when promised

• You are detail-oriented and maintain accurate documentation

• You can recognize when a family needs immediate assistance and when a lead may require longer-term nurturing

• You take initiative and do not need to be reminded to follow up

• You are dependable and take ownership of your results

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is not measured simply by the number of calls you answer.

It is measured by how effectively you help families move through the process of evaluating home care.

A successful Home Care Inquiry Specialist:

• Makes families feel heard, understood, and supported

• Develops trust quickly

• Identifies the family’s needs, concerns, and priorities

• Clearly communicates how our services can help

• Moves qualified families toward a Care Consultation

• Follows up consistently and on time

• Maintains an accurate and organized lead pipeline

• Knows exactly where every active inquiry stands

• Continues appropriate follow-up until there is a clear outcome

• Ensures that no family and no opportunity falls through the cracks

The Person We’re Looking For

An inquiry about home care is rarely just a sales lead.

Behind every inquiry is usually a family trying to solve a real problem.

A daughter may be worried about her mother living alone. A spouse may be exhausted from providing care. A family may live out of state and be struggling to figure out how to keep a parent safe at home.

The right person will genuinely want to help these families.

At the same time, helping families means providing direction.

We are looking for someone who can combine empathy, organization, persistence, and consultative sales skills to guide families toward the right next step.

You should be compassionate enough to listen, confident enough to lead the conversation, and disciplined enough to make sure every family receives the follow-up they were promised.

To Be Considered

Please submit:

• Your current resume

• A brief introduction video telling us about your experience working with prospective clients, customers, patients, or families

In your video, please also tell us:

• About your experience with Salesforce and WellSky

• How you manage follow-up when someone is interested but not yet ready to make a decision

• How you would approach a family member who is overwhelmed and unsure whether home care is the right solution

I’d use this version over the original because it still makes conversion and accountability explicit, but the candidate profile now feels much more aligned with the emotional reality of home care.
