title: Executive Assistant (100% Remote)
description:
Executive Assistant to the Principal / CEO

U.S.-based investment group (real estate and multiple business entities)

100% remote

Full-time, long-term

Schedule: Monday–Friday, Hawaii time zone (HST, UTC−10)

Compensation: $1,400–$1,600 USD per month, depending on experience



How to apply

Apply here: wkf.ms/4fG9LAL

Please include the following with your application:

1. Your resume in English, with dates (month and year) for each role.

2. A 2-minute loom video recording introducing yourself in English.

3. Your expected monthly rate in USD.

4. A short answer: "Describe how you protected an executive's time when their calendar was overloaded."



About the role

We are looking for a Senior Executive Assistant to be the right hand of the principal of a growing U.S. investment group. You will guard the executive's time and keep their calendar, inbox and priorities under control. You will also keep work moving across several companies and investments.

This is not an entry-level admin role. We want someone who thinks a step ahead and handles confidential matters with discretion. You should be able to run the executive's day with little direction.



Key responsibilities

Executive calendar and time management

• Own the executive's calendar across time zones: schedule, reschedule and protect focus time.

• D
 which meetings and requests reach the executive, and redirect or decline the rest.

• Prepare a daily and weekly agenda with briefing notes before each key meeting.

Inbox and communications

• Manage the executive's inbox: triage, draft replies and flag only what needs their attention.

• Act as the first point of contact for partners, investors, vendors and internal teams.

• Draft professional
s, letters, memos and presentations on the executive's behalf.

Meetings and follow-through

• Coordinate meetings, take notes and track action items to completion.

• Follow up with stakeholders so deadlines and commitments are not missed.

Business and investment support

• Organize documents across multiple entities: contracts, leases, closing files and e-signatures.

• Track deadlines for renewals, filings, payments and compliance.

• Support expense tracking, invoice processing and coordination with bookkeepers.

• Research and summarize information for investment and business decisions.

Travel and personal support

• Plan domestic and international travel with complete itineraries.

• Handle selected personal tasks for the executive with full discretion.

Systems and process

• Build and maintain SOPs, trackers and shared folders so nothing lives in one person's head.

• Look for ways to automate repeat tasks with tools the team already uses.



Qualifications

Required

• 5+ years as an Executive Assistant supporting a CEO, founder, owner or C-level executive, with at least 2 of those years in the last 3 years.

• Proven ownership of one executive's calendar, inbox and priorities from end to end.

• Excellent written and spoken English (C1 or higher), able to communicate with U.S. investors and partners.

• Strong skills in Google Workspace and Microsoft 365.

• Hands-on experience with at least one project management tool, such as Asana, ClickUp, Notion or 
.

• Proven discretion with confidential financial, legal and personal information.

• Highly organized, proactive and comfortable working with little supervision.

Preferred

• Previous experience as an Executive Assistant with Athena.

• Experience in real estate, investment, private equity, family office or financial services.

• Experience supporting a leader who oversees multiple companies or entities.

• Familiarity with DocuSign, QuickBooks, Expensify or 
.

• A bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

• Previous remote work for a U.S.-based company.



How to apply

Apply here: wkf.ms/4fG9LAL

1. Your resume in English, with dates (month and year) for each role.

2. A 2-minute loom video recording introducing yourself in English.

title: Social Media Moderation - DTC Brand
description:
We're hiring a remote Community & Social Engagement VA to be the voice our DTC Baby/Parent brand. You'll reply to comments, answer questions and join conversations across TikTok, Instagram,
, YouTube and Reddit and other forums/posts found online.



We are a direct-to-consumer baby carrier brand. Our customers are new and expecting parents, often tired, sometimes anxious, and always short on time. Every reply you write is how they d
 whether we're a real team who cares or just another ad, so it's important we give valuable time to these people. 



This is not a copy-paste support role. You'll help shape how the brand sounds, then keep that voice consistent in hundreds of small conversations a week.



What you'll do

• Reply to comments on our organic posts and paid ads every day: questions, compliments, objections and the occasional troll.

• Answer common questions on sizing, fit, comfort, usage and shipping clearly and accurately

• Take part in relevant Reddit threads and YouTube comment sections

• Spot, reply to or reshare customer posts and tags so happy parents feel seen.

• Hand off order problems, complaints and anything sensitive to our support team instead of handling them in public.

• Help build and maintain our brand voice guide and a library of reply examples, updating it as you learn what lands.

• Monitor negative posts, comments and clean up these areas when needed

• Keep a simple weekly log of activity and notable conversations.



What you must have

• Native or near-native English. Your writing reads naturally to a native speaker, with flawless grammar, spelling and punctuation.

• A real ear for tone. You can write warm and reassuring for a worried first-time parent, then playful on a TikTok joke, then calm and factual with a sceptic, all in the same hour.

• The ability to develop a brand voice, not just follow one. You can study a brand, describe how it sounds, and suggest ways to make it sharper.

• Platform fluency. You know how people talk on TikTok, Instagram,
, YouTube and Reddit, and why the same reply won't work on all five.

• Good judgment. You know when to answer, when to escalate, and when to stay out of it.

• Reliability. You show up daily, meet response-time targets, and communicate early when something slips.

• At least 1 year of experience managing social media or community for a brand, creator or agency.

.

Change pricing.



Negotiate custom terms.



Promise custom deliverables or services.

Group arrangements.



Special pricing requests.

title: Client Success / Marketing Assistant
description:
We are a lead generation company. We run paid advertising (Meta, Google) and outbound outreach campaigns for our clients to generate qualified leads and booked appointments for their businesses. Our clients pay us to fill their pipeline, and our job is to make sure those leads convert into real revenue for them.



We are hiring a Client Success Manager whose #1 KPI is client health and retention. Your job is to make sure every client we onboard actually succeeds with our service, stays with us long-term, and upgrades when they're ready for more.



This is NOT a general virtual assistant role. This is a client-facing account management position where you own the relationship and the outcome.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



- Checking client campaign stats daily (ad spend, cost per lead, lead volume, conversion metrics) and flagging anything that needs attention before the client ever notices a problem

- Following up with our internal team (and me directly) on changes and optimizations that need to be implemented to improve client results

- Following up with clients on actions THEY need to take to get better results (responding to leads faster, improving their sales process, showing up to calls, etc.)

- Hosting coordination calls with team members to make sure implementation actually happens on time

- Running structured check-ins with clients based on outcome milestones, not just random "checking in" messages

- Tagging every client interaction as on-track, stuck, or accelerating so we know exactly who needs attention and who's ready to upgrade

- Proactively communicating wins, progress, and recommendations to clients so they always know what we're doing for them



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You need to understand the basics of digital marketing. You don't need to be a media buyer or an ad expert, but you need to know what a cost per lead is, what a conversion rate is, what a funnel is, what a lead magnet is, what a call funnel is, and why a client's sales process matters just as much as the leads we send them. If you don't understand these concepts, you will not be able to spot problems early or have credible conversations with clients about their results.



You also need to be someone who communicates clearly in writing. Most of your client communication will be via
, Slack, or messaging. If you write like a robot or send generic "just checking in" messages, this won't work. Every message you send to a client needs to deliver value or have a clear purpose.



You need to be organized and systematic. You'll be managing multiple clients at different stages, and if you're the type who forgets to follow up or lets things slip through the cracks, clients will churn and we'll both know why.



You need to be proactive, not reactive. The whole point of this role is to catch problems before the client sees them and to surface opportunities before the client asks. If you only act when someone tells you to, this is the wrong role.



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong written English communication (this is client-facing)

- Understanding of basic digital marketing concepts (lead generation, funnels, paid ads, conversion metrics, cost per lead, ROAS)

- Experience managing client relationships, accounts, or customer success roles

- Highly organized with the ability to manage 20-40 active clients without dropping the ball

- Comfortable reviewing campaign data and identifying trends or problems

- Able to host video calls and coordinate with internal team members

- Reliable internet, quiet workspace, and availability during US business hours (we can discuss specific time zone overlap)



NICE TO HAVE



- Prior experience at a marketing agency, lead generation company, or media buying company

- Experience with Meta Ads Manager or Google Ads (even basic familiarity)

- CRM experience (GoHighLevel)

- Background in sales or account management



WHAT WE OFFER



- Long-term position with growth potential (this role evolves as we scale)

- Clear systems and training so you're not guessing what to do

- Direct access to leadership for decisions and escalations

- Competitive salary based on experience

- A role where your work directly impacts whether clients succeed and stay



HOW TO APPLY



 US at 



1. Your relevant experience (specifically any client management, account management, or customer success work)

2. Your understanding of lead generation and paid advertising (briefly explain what a cost per lead is and why a client's sales process affects their results even when we're sending them good leads)

3. Your availability and preferred working hours

4. Your salary expectations



We will review applications and reach out to candidates who are a strong fit. If you don't include the information above, we won't consider your application.



This is a real role with real responsibility. We're looking for someone who takes ownership, not someone who just wants to check boxes. If that's you, we want to talk.

title: Creative strategist
description:
Mvolo is a fast-growing Dutch direct-to-consumer brand in the light therapy space. We develop and sell science-backed red light, infrared, and daylight therapy products — and we're building a brand that actually converts. Our team is remote, results-driven, and obsessed with what works. We move fast, test constantly, and care deeply about the quality of our creative output.



The Role

We're looking for a Creative Strategist who lives in the pre-production phase of content creation. Your job is not to make the video — your job is to make sure we know exactly what to say before a single frame is shot. You'll be responsible for building the strategic foundation behind our ads and prelanders: deep customer research, identifying core beliefs and pain points, and translating those into sharp, structured copy frameworks that our creative team can execute on.



This is a thinking role as much as a writing role. If you love going deep on why customers buy, how to frame a message to move a specific audience, and what makes a hook actually land — this is for you.



What You'll Do



Conduct in-depth customer and market research (reviews, forums, competitor audits, Reddit threads, etc.) to surface real beliefs, objections, and desires

Identify the belief ladders and pain points that drive purchase decisions for our products

Build clear creative briefs and copy frameworks for prelanders and ad concepts

Write structured copy for static ads and advertorial-style content as needed

Collaborate closely with our team to refine messaging before production begins

Stay current on what's working in DTC e-commerce creative — formats, hooks, angles



What We're Looking For



Required:



Proven experience in e-commerce (DTC or marketplace), ideally with a performance marketing lens

Strong understanding of consumer psychology — beliefs, desires, objections, and how copy addresses them

Ability to conduct structured research and translate findings into clear, usable copy frameworks

Solid copywriting skills: you know the difference between a claim and a belief, and you write accordingly

Strong written English and a structured, clear communication style



Nice to have:



Experience writing prelanders or advertorials

Familiarity with Meta ad formats and what drives scroll-stopping creative

Experience with health, wellness, or physical product brands



Skills Requirement



E-Commerce

Copywriting

Content Creation

- Build cash flow forecasts and budgets

- Oversee payroll cost allocation across projects (percentage-split model)

About Us



ToplineX builds B2B revenue growth engines that help companies generate predictable pipeline. We design and run signal-driven outbound systems 
, LinkedIn, and phone) that identify the right accounts, reach them at the right time, and turn them into qualified sales conversations. Our clients range across the B2B spectrum, typically selling high-value or complex offerings where a fast, thoughtful human touch turns interest into booked meetings.

, phone, SMS) over several days with prospects who showed interest but didn't book

Goal: no interested lead ever goes cold. You own the gap between "positive reply" and "meeting held" so the founder can focus on sales calls and strategy.

description:
# Full-Time Remote Operations Coordinator  

### Philippines-Based | Long-Term | Growth Opportunity



**Site Masters Junk Removal** is a fast-growing Tampa Bay junk removal and property cleanup company. We are hiring a long-term **Remote Operations Coordinator** to help keep our customers, technicians, trucks, schedules, estimates, invoices, and job documentation organized.



This is not a basic data-entry role. You will help operate the remote control tower of a growing field-service business.



We value people who are organized, proactive, calm under pressure, honest, and willing to take ownership.



## Main Responsibilities



### Operations and Scheduling



- Build and update daily technician routes.

- Confirm job addresses, timing, crew assignments, and special instructions.

- Communicate route information to technicians.

- Monitor delays, schedule changes, callouts, and vehicle issues.

- Coordinate with the field operations manager regarding truck, equipment, and safety issues.

- Keep Jobber and internal records accurate.

- Track open issues until they have an owner and next action.



### Customer Communication



- Answer customer messages and provide professional updates.

- Communicate ETAs, delays, reschedules, and missing information.

- Request photos for remote estimates.

- Follow up with customers when details are incomplete.

- Document customer conversations and commitments.

- Escalate complaints, property damage, payment issues, and unusual requests.



### Estimates, Invoices, and Follow-Up



- Prepare draft estimates using approved pricing procedures.

- Prepare and send invoices.

- Follow up on open quotes and unpaid invoices.

- Request deposits or payments when required.

- Review job details before customer-facing documents are sent.

- Escalate pricing questions or unusual discounts for approval.

- Call technicians to communicate timelines and changes and ensure on-time delivery (you will be using the phone in this role)



### Job Documentation and Quality Control



- Review before-and-after photos.

- Organize customer photo albums and Google Drive folders.

- Request missing or unclear job documentation.

- Confirm notes, photos, payments, and invoices are completed.

- Track incomplete jobs until they are properly closed.



### Phone Support



You may also answer company phone lines as backup support. Depending on your experience and performance, phone responsibilities may become a larger part of the role.



Phone responsibilities may include:



- Answering inbound customer calls.

- Qualifying leads.

- Booking appointments.

- Gathering job details and photos.

- Handling basic pricing questions using approved guidelines.

- Documenting calls accurately.

- Escalating sales, safety, and customer-service issues.



## Requirements



- Previous virtual assistant experience is required.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Ability to work Monday through Saturday, approximately **8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Eastern Time**.

- Minimum typing speed of **50 WPM**.

- Reliable computer capable of handling multiple browser tabs and software systems.

- **At least 8GB RAM, SSD storage, and a second monitor available from the start.**

- Reliable primary internet connection.

- Backup internet or mobile data.

- Quiet workspace and reliable headset for phone support.

- Strong attention to detail and follow-through.

- Comfortable learning software quickly.

- Able to stay calm while handling multiple urgent issues.

- Willing to receive direct feedback and improve.



Experience with Jobber, Google Workspace, Google Sheets, CRMs, dispatch, customer service, logistics, or home-service businesses is preferred.



## Compensation



- **$1,200 to $1,500 USD per month to start**, depending on experience and performance.

- Paid trial period.

- Compensation can increase as you demonstrate independent ownership, accuracy, phone ability, and reduced need for supervision.

- Strong performers can grow into senior operations or team-lead responsibility.



This is a long-term opportunity. We are building a serious remote operations team, not looking for someone to complete random short-term tasks.



## Core Values



### Unshakable Integrity



Tell the truth, communicate early, follow through, and own mistakes.



### Extreme Ownership



Do not simply forward problems. Identify the next action, assign ownership, and follow up until the issue is resolved.



### Relentlessly Driven



Learn quickly, improve constantly, and perform at a high level without needing to be chased.



### Calm Under Pressure



Operations create problems every day. We solve them clearly, professionally, and without spreading confusion.

title: Creative Designer & Meta Ads specialist
description:
# Creative & Meta Ads Specialist

**Remote | ParfumCentral**



ParfumCentral is a fast-growing luxury fragrance retailer based in Dubai, specializing in **Gulf exclusives, early releases, discontinued fragrances, and hard-to-find niche bottles.**



We’re looking for someone who is strong in **both creative design and Meta Ads**.



You should have a sharp eye for premium visuals, branding, and advertising creative, while also being comfortable managing Meta campaigns, reading performance data, and understanding what makes a creative perform.



We want someone who can move between both sides of the role naturally — **creating the work, launching it, reading the results, and improving the next version.**



This is not a role for someone who is only a designer and plans to learn Meta Ads after joining. You should already have hands-on experience with both.



## What You’ll Be Doing



- Designing high-quality creatives for Instagram and

- Creating static ads, carousels, stories, banners, and short-form video content

- Developing visual concepts that fit a premium luxury brand

- Creating different ad angles, hooks, and creative variations for testing

- Managing and optimizing Meta advertising campaigns

- Setting up campaigns, audiences, budgets, and testing structures

- Looking at campaign performance and identifying which creatives are working best

- Using performance data to improve future creative

- Testing different products, messages, audiences, and visual approaches

- Knowing when a campaign or creative needs to be adjusted, scaled, replaced, or paused

- Supporting audience growth across Instagram and other social platforms

- Suggesting ideas to improve engagement, reach, follower growth, and conversion

- Using AI tools where helpful to speed up concept development, creative testing, image generation, editing, and content production

- Keeping up with trends across fragrance, luxury, fashion, e-commerce, social media, and advertising

- Working closely with us to continuously improve both the visual direction and performance of the brand



The ideal person should be able to look at a campaign and think:



**“This creative could be stronger — here’s what I would change.”**



But also:



**“This campaign is underperforming — here’s what I think is causing it, and here’s what I’d test next.”**



## What We’re Looking For



You should have:



- A strong design portfolio

- Good taste and strong attention to detail

- Experience creating polished social media and advertising creatives

- A good understanding of visual hierarchy, typography, composition, and branding

- Experience with Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, Canva, or similar tools

- Basic-to-strong video editing skills

- Experience using AI tools for creative production, concept development, image generation, content creation, or ad variations



You should also already be comfortable with:



- Meta Ads Manager

- Campaign setup and optimization

- Creative testing

- Audience testing

- Prospecting and retargeting

- Reading ad performance

- Understanding metrics such as CTR, CPA, CPC, CPM, ROAS, conversion rate, and frequency

- Using campaign results to make better creative and advertising decisions



You do not need to be a specialist media buyer.



However, **Meta Ads experience must be practical, not theoretical.**



If your experience is mainly design and you are hoping to learn Meta Ads in the role, this position is not the right fit.



Experience with **luxury, fragrance, fashion, beauty, or premium e-commerce brands** is a strong advantage.



## The Person We Want



We’re looking for someone who is:



- Creative

- Visually sharp

- Analytical

- Proactive

- Reliable

- Detail-oriented

- Comfortable taking ownership of their work

- Interested in both design and performance

- Able to suggest ideas instead of just waiting for instructions

- Curious about why certain creatives and campaigns perform better than others



We want someone who can create something strong, put it into market, study what happens, and make the next version better.



## Compensation



**Base pay + performance incentives**



You’ll receive a guaranteed base rate, with additional bonuses tied to performance and results.



As the brand grows and your work contributes to stronger campaigns, sales, and social growth, we want you to benefit from that as well.



## About ParfumCentral



ParfumCentral gives fragrance enthusiasts access to products that are often difficult to find outside the Gulf.



Our focus is on:



**Gulf Exclusives. Early Drops. Discontinued & Hard-to-Find Fragrances.**



We sell internationally across markets including the **UAE, United States, United Kingdom, Europe, and Australia.**



We’re still growing quickly, which means the right person will have plenty of room to shape both the creative direction and advertising performance of the brand over time.



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction

2. Your design portfolio

4. Your experience managing Meta Ads

5. An example of a Meta campaign you personally worked on and what you did

8. Your expected hourly or monthly rate



**Please only apply if you already have hands-on experience with both creative design and Meta Ads.**



Please include **“Scarlet Sands”** somewhere in your application so we know you read the full post.

title: Reinforcement (Reo) Scheduler / Rebar Detailer – Australian Standards (AS 3600)
description:
Metarom Steel is a structural steel fabricator in Melbourne, Australia. We're setting up a new reinforcement processing division that will make reo cages for footings, precast panels, beams, columns and bored piers. We're looking for an experienced reo scheduler to work with our team as the division grows.



What you'll do



Read Australian structural engineering drawings: plans, sections and details.

Prepare bar bending schedules to AS 3600 and AS/NZS 4671, using bar marks, Australian shape codes, laps, cogs, cover and bend diameters.

Schedule reinforcement for footings, slabs, beams, columns, precast and tilt panels, and bored pier cages.

Split bars to stock lengths (6 m / 12 m) and keep offcuts to a minimum.

Prepare cage assembly drawings and marking plans.

Produce tonnage summaries by bar size for estimating and ordering.

Export schedules for CNC machines (BVBS or CSV) once our machinery is installed.



Must have



At least 2 years' experience scheduling reinforcement for Australian projects, ideally for an Australian reinforcing processor or detailing company.

Solid knowledge of AS 3600 detailing rules and Australian bar sizes (N10–N40) and shape codes.

Experience with reo scheduling software, such as RebarCAD, aSa, Tekla (rebar) or similar.

AutoCAD.

Good written English, accuracy and attention to detail.

Available to work during Melbourne business hours (roughly 6am–3pm Philippine time).

Reliable internet and your own computer.



Nice to have



Precast or tilt panel reinforcement experience.

Bored pier and pile cage scheduling.

Estimating and quantity take-offs for tenders.

Revit or Tekla 3D rebar modelling.

Some structural steel detailing experience.



How to apply



Start your application with the word "N16" so we know you've read this post.

Tell us which Australian companies or projects you've scheduled for, and roughly how many tonnes per month you usually schedule.

List the scheduling software you use.

Attach 1–2 sample bar schedules or drawings, with confidential details removed.



Shortlisted applicants will be given a paid test job: scheduling a small set of Australian beam cages or footings from engineer's drawings.

This is a full-time role and you will be working as part of a talented and supportive team. You will be involved in managing day to day communications with our clients, providing front line support and assistance, assigning tasks to the development team, identifying potential upsell opportunities and in general, providing a friendly, dynamic, responsive and helpful face to our existing clients. 

You will be working with our project management team, our sales team and with our web design and web development team to help drive continuous improvement within the company. 



Principal Accountabilities / Responsibilities



Client Support:

- We use the SugarCRM ticketing system which supports our global web teams. The successful candidate for this role will need to play a key role in helping to manage and refine the Sugar ticketing system and be a contact point internally for any issues, training, and general support requests related to the system.

 - for updates, changes, questions on their website and/or our services etc.

- Maintain and monitor requests using Sugar Serve (the Group ticketing system) where support requests are logged and tracked. Our website clients purchase support hours against which site updates and changes are made, these need to not only be kept up to date, but when running low, a client will need to be contacted to request that additional hours are purchased.

- Be able to provide individual reports to clients who request to see a log of all site updates and changes over a given period. 

- Proactively contact clients ahead of financial announcements or other key dates in order to manage site updates in advance. 

- Note that while the role is full time and normal office hours, there will be times when a client request requires an early morning, evening or weekend activity. This is typically managed and agreed in advance but this role does require some flexibility around working hours.



Person Specification



The successful candidate will demonstrate the following core strengths:

- Native-like English speaker

- Excellent verbal and written skills 

- Ability to multi-task and prioritise in a deadline driven environment 

- Excellent task management and organizational skills

- Dynamic, self motivated and proactive, able to work quickly and accurately 

- Experienced working in an office environment, using PC or Mac, working with MS Office products etc.

- Demonstrable understanding of web design and web development projects

Desirable Skills 

- Experience of CRMs, ideally Sugar CRM 

- Experience of WordPress 

- Some understanding of the stock market, investor relations tools and investor communities would be beneficial

- Experience of Google Analytics and SEO



Work Environment - What We Offer



In return we offer a competitive salary in a central location, a professional environment, flexible working hours and the opportunity to learn about the financial markets and the companies that operate within them.

You will work in an established but innovative organisation and get to be part of a fast-growing company which offers a challenge and a great opportunity to develop your skills.

You will also be able to expand your understanding of the financial markets and help us expand the services and products that we are able to offer. You will also be able to input into our own website and general company branding.



Screening Questions

title: SDR - PLEASE INCLUDE VOICE RECORDING
description:
APPLICATIONS WITHOUT A VOICE RECORDING INCLUDED WON'T BE CONSIDERED



About Us



ToplineX builds B2B revenue growth engines that help companies generate predictable pipeline. We design and run signal-driven outbound systems 
, LinkedIn, and phone) that identify the right accounts, reach them at the right time, and turn them into qualified sales conversations. Our clients range across the B2B spectrum, typically selling high-value or complex offerings where a fast, thoughtful human touch turns interest into booked meetings.



We're looking for an SDR to own the pipeline: every positive reply, inbound lead, and past conversation, turned into held meetings.



What You'll Be Doing



You will work directly with the founder and own everything that happens after a prospect shows interest.



Your responsibilities include:



- Monitoring campaign inboxes and responding to positive replies within 15 minutes during working hours (AI assisted)

- Calling interested prospects to qualify them and get the meeting booked

- Running multi-touch follow-up sequences 
, phone, SMS) over several days with prospects who showed interest but didn't book

- Maximising show rates: confirmations, SMS and
 reminders, and re-engaging no-shows to get them rebooked

- Re-engaging inbound leads, older lists, and people we've spoken to in the past

- Keeping the CRM clean and up to date, with short daily activity updates and weekly pipeline reporting

- Supporting the founder in the sales motion: pre-call research, post-call follow-ups, chasing proposals

- Over time, taking ownership of outreach campaigns and building proactive plays to reach the right people at the right time



Goal: no interested lead ever goes cold. You own the gap between "positive reply" and "meeting held" so the founder can focus on sales calls and strategy.



What Success Looks Like



- Speed to lead: positive replies answered within 15 minutes during working hours

- Meetings booked, and more importantly, meetings held

- Show rate of 80%+ through tight confirmation and reminder sequences

- A pipeline where every lead has a next step and nothing slips through the cracks



Who Is This Role For



This role is perfect for someone who:



- Has worked in an SDR, BDR, or appointment-setting function before

- Is comfortable and confident picking up the phone and speaking to senior, high-value prospects

- Wants ownership and responsibility for the pipeline, not just task execution

- Understands the world of GTM and lead generation (cold
, outbound, how agencies work)

- Is proactive: spots opportunities and acts on them without being asked

- Likes working in fast-moving startup environments





Required Skills & Experience



Must have:



- Experience in an SDR, BDR, or appointment-setter role (B2B preferred), with results you can point to (meetings booked, show rates, campaign reports)

- Confident cold and warm calling: able to handle objections and convert a conversation into a booked meeting

- Fluent spoken and written English, with neutral/American accent

- Understanding of B2B outbound and lead generation fundamentals

- Comfortable using AI tools in your daily work

- Strong attention to detail and disciplined follow-up

- Ability to work autonomously once direction is given

- A professional remote setup: quiet workspace, headset, reliable computer, stable internet, and backup power/internet so you're never offline during working hours



Bonus if you have:



- Experience running automated outbound yourself (Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist, Clay, or similar)

- Experience with LinkedIn outreach or social selling

- Experience writing or improving outbound and follow-up sequences

- Experience with CRMs and dialers



Working Styles & Expectations



- Full-time remote role

- Working hours aligned to US business hours, worked live (speed to lead is the job, so this is not a batch-work role)

- Fast execution environment with direct founder collaboration

- Short daily check-ins on Slack, weekly pipeline reviews





What's In It For You (+ Growth Opportunity)



This is a full-time salaried role from day one. In addition to base salary, compensation includes revenue share on the clients we sign, so your earnings grow directly with the pipeline you help build.



As the company grows, this role can evolve into:



- Senior SDR / Account Executive (running sales calls yourself)

- Owning the full pipeline function and leading future SDR hires

- Greater revenue share and performance incentives



We want someone who grows with us long-term, takes ownership, and benefits directly as the business expands.

title: Experienced Creative Strategist for a Beauty & Supplement E-Commerce
description:
We’re looking for an experienced Creative Strategist with a strong background in DTC/e-commerce, especially within beauty, skincare, and supplement brands.



This is a performance-focused role. We’re not only looking for someone who can create good-looking ads, but we want someone who understands what makes creatives spend, scale, and generate profitable ROAS.



What You’ll Do

- Develop fresh creative concepts and angles for our beauty and supplement products.

- Create video and static ad concepts for Meta.

- Write hooks, scripts, headlines, ad copy, and detailed creative briefs.

- Research competitors, customer reviews, trends, winning ads, and new opportunities.

- Develop concepts for different personas and stages of awareness.

- Analyze Spend, ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR, and other creative performance metrics.

- Identify winning creatives and develop iterations to help them scale.

- Work closely with our media buyers, editors, and designers.

- Ensure ad messaging and creative angles align with our landing/product pages.

- Understand how to communicate beauty and supplement benefits while keeping claims appropriate.



Who We’re Looking For

You must have previous experience as a Creative Strategist for DTC/e-commerce brands.



Experience with beauty/skincare and supplements is highly preferred.



You should understand:

- Meta/Facebook advertising

- Direct-response creative strategy

- UGC and static advertising

- Creative testing and iteration

- Customer psychology and market awareness

- Performance metrics, particularly Spend and ROAS



⚠️ IMPORTANT:  PORTFOLIO REQUIREMENT



Please do not apply without providing proof of previous creative performance.



Before we consider an application, you MUST attach a portfolio containing examples of ads/creatives you personally strategized.



For each relevant creative, please provide:

AD/CREATIVE

→ Your involvement/role

→ Total Ad Spend

→ ROAS

→ Other relevant results (CPA, CTR, purchases, etc., if available)

→ Proof of performance (screenshots from Meta Ads Manager or another verifiable source)



The Spend metric is especially important to us.



We want to see creatives that didn't simply achieve a strong ROAS on a small test budget; we want to understand how much spend the creative was able to handle while maintaining performance.



Applications that provide creative examples without Spend + ROAS + supporting proof may not be considered.



Let us know also your hourly rate.

, TikTok, and YouTube, and you will assist in editing videos that make those channels worth following. You plan the month, assign content to the team, keep everyone on schedule, and make sure everything that gets posted sounds like us and looks great.

Full time, 40 hours per week, US Central business hours.

$900 to $1,100 USD per month depending on experience, paid weekly. Growth available as our channels and team scale.



>>To Apply<<



Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed. Include:



A link to your video editing portfolio. Tell us which pieces you edited start to finish.

A social account you managed, plus one result you are proud of and how you got it.

Responsibilities

Set up, manage, and troubleshoot Google Tag Manager (GTM) containers, tags, triggers, and variables.

Implement and maintain server-side tracking solutions for ecommerce websites.

Configure events, conversion actions, and custom events to ensure accurate data collection.

Audit existing tracking setups, identify issues, and implement solutions to improve data accuracy.

Requirements

Strong practical experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM), including advanced tag configuration and troubleshooting.

Solid understanding of server-side tracking and the ability to implement and debug server-side tagging solutions.
